                                   ActindoOrders.id := JSONBuffer.Path;

                                   ActindoOrders.INSERT;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetSalesOrder@301480000() : Boolean;
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301480000 : Record 36;
    BEGIN
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",ExternalDocumentNo);
      EXIT(NOT SalesHeader.ISEMPTY);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetQuickSalesOrder@1000000000() : Boolean;
    VAR
      QuickSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 5104606;
      result@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",ExternalDocumentNo);
      EXIT(NOT QuickSalesHeader.ISEMPTY);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetPaymentMethod@301480001() : Text;
    VAR
      QuickSalesHeader@301480000 : Record 5104606;
    BEGIN
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",ExternalDocumentNo);
      IF QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        EXIT(QuickSalesHeader."Payment Method Code");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetOrderInSystem@1000000001();
    VAR
      ActindoOrders@1000000000 : Record 50000;
      QuickSalesHeader@1000000001 : Record 5104606;
    BEGIN
      quickSalesOrderCounter := 0;
      IF ActindoOrders.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",ActindoOrders.ExternalDocumentNo);
          IF NOT QuickSalesHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
            quickSalesOrderCounter +=1;
        UNTIL ActindoOrders.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    {

      // temp. objekte fÅr Åbernahme altauftrÑge

        //SerialNo := lItemAttributeValueMapping."Serial No.";
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Insert_Rec@301510000(VAR PEntry@301510000 : Record 50009);
    VAR
      PaygateEntry1@301510001 : Record 50009;
    BEGIN
      IF PEntry.Residual > 0 THEN BEGIN
      PaygateEntry1.INIT;
      PaygateEntry1."Entry No.":=SetEntryNo;
      PaygateEntry1."Document No.":=PEntry."Document No.";
      PaygateEntry1."Document Position":=SetEntryNoDoc(PaygateEntry_Var."Document No.");
      PaygateEntry1."Customer No.":=PaygateEntry_Var."Customer No.";
      PaygateEntry1."Document Amount":=PaygateEntry_Var."Document Amount";
      PaygateEntry1."Insert Date":=TODAY;
      PaygateEntry1."Inserted from":=USERID;
      IF NOT PaygateEntry1.INSERT() THEN BEGIN
        PaygateEntry1.MODIFY;
      END;
      PEntry:=PaygateEntry1;

      COMMIT;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetVisible@301510001();
    VAR
      PaygateEntry@301510000 : Record 50009;
      PSPLog@301510001 : Record 5227626;
      SalesPSPCard@301510002 : Record 5227625;
      FoundOpenReserveCall@301510003 : Boolean;
      LocDateTime@301510004 : DateTime;
      LocDatetimeEntry@301510005 : DateTime;
    BEGIN
      ShowCancelled:=FALSE;
      VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
      VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
      ShowCapture:=FALSE;
      FoundOpenReserveCall:=FALSE;
      ReservAfterCancelled:=FALSE;
      ReservAgainAfterPrePa:=FALSE;
      DeleteandCreate:=FALSE;
      SetStyle:='Standard';
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function,'PREPARE');
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("I_Error Code",'COMPLETED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN
        IF SalesPSPCard.GET(SalesPSPCard."Document Type"::Order,PSPLog.O_OrderID) THEN
          IF SalesPSPCard.ReferencModify = '' THEN BEGIN
            //IF NOT ShowCancelled THEN
            VisibleReserve:=TRUE;
            ShowCapture:=FALSE;
            SetStyle:='Standard';
          END ELSE BEGIN
            VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
            ShowCapture:=FALSE;
            SetStyle:='Favorable';
            ReservAgainAfterPrePa:=TRUE;
          END;
      PaygateEntry.RESET;
      PaygateEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
      IF PaygateEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IF NOT FoundOpenReserveCall THEN BEGIN
            PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry",PaygateEntry."LogNo PSP");
            PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function,'RESERVE');
            PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'%1|%2','','PENDING');
            IF PSPLog.FIND('-') THEN  BEGIN
              VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
              VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
              ShowCapture:=FALSE;
              FoundOpenReserveCall:=TRUE;
            END;
          END;
        UNTIL PaygateEntry.NEXT =0;
      END;
      //Gutscheineinlîsung bei erste Datensatz
      PaygateEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
      VisibleVoucher:=PaygateEntry.COUNT=1;
      //Gutscheineinlîsung bei erste Datensatz
      //Steuerung nochmal reservieren
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function, 'RESERVE');
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("I_Error Code", 'FAILED');
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(Checked,FALSE);
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN
        VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function, 'REVERSAL');
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("I_Error Code", 'COMPLETED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
        VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
      END;
      //Reservierung auflîsen
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function, 'RESERVE');
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("I_Error Code", 'COMPLETED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        ResetVisible:=TRUE;
        ShowCapture:=TRUE;
        VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
      END;
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETRANGE(O_Function, 'CAPTURE');
      //PSPLog.SETRANGE("I_Error Code", 'COMPLETED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        ResetVisible:=FALSE;
        ShowCapture:=FALSE;
        VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
        VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
      END;
      //anzeige Storno
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1|%2','PREPARE','CREATE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'<>%1&<>%2','COMPLETED','CANCELLED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        LocDateTime:=CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,TIME);
        LocDatetimeEntry:=PSPLog."Log Timestamp"+60000;
        IF LocDatetimeEntry < LocDateTime  THEN BEGIN
          ShowCancelled:=TRUE;
          //VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
          VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
          ResetVisible:=FALSE;
        END;
      END;
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','RESERVE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'<>%1&<>%2','COMPLETED','CANCELLED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        LocDateTime:=CREATEDATETIME(TODAY,TIME);
        LocDatetimeEntry:=PSPLog."Log Timestamp"+60000;
        IF LocDatetimeEntry < LocDateTime THEN BEGIN
          ShowCancelled:=TRUE;
          //VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
          VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
          ResetVisible:=FALSE;
        END;
      END;
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','RESERVE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'%1','CANCELLED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
      VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
      VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
      ResetVisible:=FALSE;
      IF PSPLog."Transaction OK" THEN
        ReservAfterCancelled:=TRUE;
      END;
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','RESERVE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'%1','PENDING');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
        VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
        ResetVisible:=FALSE;
        IF PSPLog."Transaction OK" THEN BEGIN
          PSPLog."Transaction OK":=FALSE;
          PSPLog.MODIFY;
        END;
      END;
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','PREPARE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'%1','PENDING');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        ShowCancelled:=TRUE;
        VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
        VisibleReserve:=FALSE;
        ResetVisible:=FALSE;
      END;
      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','PREPARE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'%1','CANCELLED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        IF PSPLog.COUNT = 1 THEN
          VisibleReserveAgain:=TRUE;
      END;

      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','PREPARE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'<>%1','COMPLETED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        IF PSPLog.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
          DeleteandCreate:=TRUE;
          VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
        END;
      END;

      PSPLog.RESET;
      PSPLog.SETRANGE("Log Entry","LogNo PSP");
      PSPLog.SETFILTER(O_Function,'%1','CREATE');
      PSPLog.SETFILTER("I_Error Code",'<>%1','COMPLETED');
      IF PSPLog.FIND('+') THEN BEGIN
        IF PSPLog.COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
          DeleteandCreate:=TRUE;
          VisibleReserveAgain:=FALSE;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      //00 06.09.21 NKON Page angelegt.
    }
    END.
  }

                               END;
                                }
    }

  {
    VAR
      ChronextComission@301510000 : Decimal;
      CostAmount@301510001 : Decimal;
      Source@301510002 : Text;
      PurchasePosted@301510003 : Boolean;
      gVariant@301510004 : Text;
      gPurchaseOrderNo@301510005 : Code[20];
      gPurchaseInvNo@301510006 : Code[20];
      gVendorNo@301510007 : ARRAY [3] OF Code[20];
      EndOfReturnPeriod@301510008 : Date;
      gVendorText@301510009 : Text;
      ServiceInvAmount@301510010 : Decimal;
      gChronextPerc@301510011 : ARRAY [2] OF Decimal;
      gChronextMargin@301510012 : ARRAY [2] OF Decimal;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateCosts@301510000();
    VAR
      NuveiManagement@301510000 : Codeunit 50041;
    BEGIN
      CLEARALL;
      CostAmount := NuveiManagement.FindCosts_Inv(Rec."No.",Rec."External Document No.",PurchasePosted,gPurchaseOrderNo,gPurchaseInvNo,gVendorNo);
      IF gVendorNo[1] <> '' THEN
        gVendorText := gVendorNo[1];
      IF gVendorNo[2] <> '' THEN
        gVendorText := gVendorText + ',' + gVendorNo[2];

      IF CostAmount = 0 THEN
        ChronextComission := Rec."Amount Including VAT"
      ELSE
        ChronextComission := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - CostAmount;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetSource@301510001();
    VAR
      UnpostedDocumentValue@301510000 : Record 5295670;
      LineNo@301510001 : Integer;
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510002 : Record 113;
    BEGIN
      Source := '';
      SalesInvoiceLine.RESET;
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",Rec."No.");
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesInvoiceLine.Type::Item);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          UnpostedDocumentValue.RESET;
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source No.",Rec."External Document No.");
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE(Key,'#F85058#');
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETRANGE("Source Line No.",SalesInvoiceLine."Line No.");
          UnpostedDocumentValue.SETCURRENTKEY("Source Line No.");
          IF UnpostedDocumentValue.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
            REPEAT
              IF Source = '' THEN
                Source := UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueText
              ELSE
                Source := Source + '_'+ UnpostedDocumentValue.ValueText;
            UNTIL UnpostedDocumentValue.NEXT = 0;
          END;
        UNTIL SalesInvoiceLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;


      EndOfReturnPeriod := Rec."Posting Date";
      IF Source = 'C2C' THEN
        EndOfReturnPeriod := CALCDATE('18D',Rec."Posting Date");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetVariant@301510002();
    VAR
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510000 : Record 113;
    BEGIN
      gVariant := '';

      SalesInvoiceLine.RESET;
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",Rec."No.");
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Type,SalesInvoiceLine.Type::Item);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER("No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          IF gVariant = '' THEN
            gVariant := SalesInvoiceLine."Variant Code"
          ELSE
            gVariant := gVariant + ',' + SalesInvoiceLine."Variant Code";
        UNTIL SalesInvoiceLine.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OpenPurchase@301510003();
    VAR
      PurchInvHeader@301510000 : Record 122;
      PostedPurchaseInvoice@301510001 : Page 138;
      PurchaseOrder@301510002 : Page 50;
      PurchaseHeader@301510003 : Record 38;
    BEGIN
      IF gPurchaseInvNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        PurchInvHeader.GET(gPurchaseInvNo);
        PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Posted Purchase Invoice", PurchInvHeader);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PurchaseHeader.GET(PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order,gPurchaseOrderNo);
        PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Purchase Order", PurchaseHeader);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ServiceInvoice@301510004();
    VAR
      Vendor@301510000 : Record 23;
      Customer@301510001 : Record 18;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510002 : Record 112;
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510003 : Record 113;
      PurchInvHeader@301510004 : Record 122;
      PurchaseHeader@301510005 : Record 38;
    BEGIN
      IF gPurchaseInvNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        PurchInvHeader.GET(gPurchaseInvNo);
        gPurchaseOrderNo := PurchInvHeader."Order No.";
      END;

      ServiceInvAmount := 0;
      IF Vendor.GET(gVendorNo[1]) THEN BEGIN
        Customer.RESET;
        Customer.SETRANGE(Name,Vendor.Name);
        IF Customer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.",Customer."No.");
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",'');
            IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
              REPEAT
                SalesInvoiceLine.RESET;
                SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesInvoiceHeader."No.");
                SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER(Description,'%1','*'+gPurchaseOrderNo+'*');
                IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN
                  ServiceInvAmount += SalesInvoiceLine."Amount Including VAT"
                ELSE BEGIN
                  SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Description);
                  IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                    IF SalesInvoiceLine.Description = '' THEN BEGIN
                      IF SalesInvoiceHeader."Posting Date" < 010526D THEN BEGIN
                        SalesInvoiceHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
                        ServiceInvAmount += SalesInvoiceHeader."Amount Including VAT";
                      END;
                    END;
                  END;
                END;
              UNTIL SalesInvoiceHeader.NEXT = 0;
            END;
          UNTIL Customer.NEXT = 0;
        END;
      END;
      IF ServiceInvAmount <> 0 THEN BEGIN
        ChronextComission := ChronextComission + ServiceInvAmount;
        CostAmount := CostAmount - ServiceInvAmount;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetItemLedgerEntries@301510005();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;
      ItemLedgerEntries@301510001 : Page 38;
      ItemFilter@301510002 : Text;
    BEGIN
      ItemFilter := GetItemFilter(Rec."No.");
      CLEAR(ItemLedgerEntries);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.", ItemFilter);
      ItemLedgerEntries.SETTABLEVIEW(ItemLedgerEntry);
      ItemLedgerEntries.EDITABLE(FALSE);
      ItemLedgerEntries.RUN;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetItemFilter@301510006(InvoiceNo@301510003 : Code[20]) : Text;
    VAR
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510000 : Record 113;
      ItemListFilter@301510002 : Text;
      FirstData@301510001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      FirstData := TRUE;
      CLEAR(ItemListFilter);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.", InvoiceNo);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Type, SalesInvoiceLine.Type::Item);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER("Processing Status", '<>%1', SalesInvoiceLine."Processing Status"::cancelled);
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER("No.", '<>BOX');
      SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER(Quantity,'<>%1',0);
      IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF NOT FirstData THEN
            ItemListFilter := ItemListFilter + '|';
            FirstData := FALSE;

          ItemListFilter := ItemListFilter + SalesInvoiceLine."No.";
        UNTIL SalesInvoiceLine.NEXT = 0;

      EXIT(ItemListFilter);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OpenVendorLedgerEntries@301510007();
    VAR
      VendorLedgerEntries@301510000 : Page 29;
      VendorLedgerEntry@301510001 : Record 25;
    BEGIN
      IF gVendorNo[1] <> '' THEN BEGIN
        VendorLedgerEntry.RESET;
        VendorLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Vendor No.",gVendorNo[1]);
        PAGE.RUN(PAGE::"Vendor Ledger Entries",VendorLedgerEntry);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateMargin@301510008();
    BEGIN
      gChronextPerc[1] := (ChronextComission * 100) / Rec."Amount Including VAT";
      gChronextPerc[1] := ROUND(gChronextPerc[1],0.01);
      gChronextMargin[1] := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - CostAmount;

      gChronextPerc[2] := ((ChronextComission-ServiceInvAmount) * 100) / Rec."Amount Including VAT";
      gChronextPerc[2] := ROUND(gChronextPerc[2],0.01);
      gChronextMargin[2] := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - (ChronextComission + ServiceInvAmount);
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateCosts@301510000();
    VAR
      NuveiManagement@301510000 : Codeunit 50041;
      bool@301510001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      VendorAmount := 0;
      ChronextAmount := 0;

      VendorAmount := NuveiManagement.FindCosts_Inv(Rec."No.",Rec."External Document No.",bool,OrderNo,InvoiceNo,VendorNo);

      IF VendorAmount = 0 THEN
        ChronextAmount := Rec."Amount Including VAT"
      ELSE
        ChronextAmount := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - VendorAmount;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateAmounts@301510001(pType@301510000 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      CASE pType OF
        1 : "Nuvei Chronext Comission" := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - "Nuvei Vendor Amount";
        2 : "Nuvei Vendor Amount" := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - "Nuvei Chronext Comission";
      END;
      Rec.MODIFY;
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetVisible@301510002(Type@301510000 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      CASE Type OF
        1 : BEGIN
          gVisible1 := TRUE;
          gVisible2 := TRUE;
        END;
        2 : BEGIN
          gVisible1 := TRUE;
          gVisible2 := FALSE;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

OBJECT Page 50022 LV Order Status Entity
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=02.07.26;
    Time=10:19:37;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    SourceTable=Table5104606;
    SourceTableView=WHERE(Order Date=FILTER(01.06.26..31.12.26),
                          IsConsignment=CONST(Yes));
    PageType=API;
    EntitySetName=LVPaymentStatus;
    EntityName=LVPaymentStatus;
    OnAfterGetRecord=BEGIN
                       FindPaymentStatus;
                     END;

    ODataKeyFields=External Document No.;
  }
  CONTROLS
  {
    { 301510000;0;Container;
                ContainerType=ContentArea }

    { 301510001;1;Group   ;
                Name=Group;
                GroupType=Repeater }

    { 301510002;2;Field   ;
                SourceExpr="External Document No." }

    { 301510003;2;Field   ;
                Name=PaymentStatus;
                SourceExpr=PaymentStatus }

  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      PaymentStatus@301510000 : Text;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindPaymentStatus@301510000();
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510001 : Record 112;
    BEGIN
      PaymentStatus := '';
      IF Rec.IsConsignment = FALSE THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Rec.Workflow = Rec.Workflow::"Document created" THEN BEGIN
        IF SalesHeader.GET(1,Rec."External Document No.") THEN BEGIN
          IF SalesHeader.Status = SalesHeader.Status::Released THEN
            PaymentStatus := 'Paid'
          ELSE BEGIN
            SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Approve Order");
            CASE SalesHeader."Status Approve Order" OF
              SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved:
                PaymentStatus := 'Paid';
              SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::"Waiting For Approval":
                PaymentStatus := 'Pending';
              SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Cancelled:
                PaymentStatus := 'Rejected';
            END;
          END;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
          SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",Rec."External Document No.");
          IF SalesInvoiceHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
             PaymentStatus := 'Order Cancelled'
          ELSE
             PaymentStatus := 'Order Completed';
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetLastEntryNo@301510000() : Integer;
    VAR
      VTRec@301510000 : Record 50015;
    BEGIN
      VTRec.RESET;
      IF VTRec.FINDLAST THEN
        EXIT(VTRec."Entry No");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertRecordFromGMBH@301510001();
    VAR
      Inventory@301510002 : Record 50015;
      SalesPrice@301510000 : Record 7002;
      PurchasePrice@301510001 : Record 7012;
    BEGIN
      ILE.RESET;
      ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
      ILE.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      ILE.SETFILTER("Remaining Quantity",'>=%1',1);
      IF ILE.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
        Inventory.INIT;
        Inventory."Entry No":= GetLastEntryNo+1;
        Inventory."Item No":= ILE."Item No.";
        Inventory."Variant code":= ILE."Variant Code";
        Inventory."Location code":=ILE."Location Code";
        Inventory."Company Name":= COMPANYNAME;
        Inventory.Qty:= ILE."Remaining Quantity";
        Inventory.SerialNo:= ILE."Serial No.";
        Inventory."Entry Type":= ILE."Entry Type";
        Inventory."Vendor No.":= ILE."Source No.";
        Inventory."Differential Taxation Purchase":=ILE."Differential Taxation Purchase";
        ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
        Inventory."Purchase Price":= ILE."Cost Amount (Actual)";
        IF Inventory."Purchase Price"=0.0 THEN BEGIN
          Inventory."Purchase Price Expected":= ILE."Cost Amount (Expected)";
          ILE.CALCFIELDS("Purchase Order No.");
          Inventory."Purchase Order No":= ILE."Purchase Order No.";
        END;
        Inventory.Brand := GetAttributevalue(27,ILE."Item No.",'',1);
        Inventory.Model := GetAttributevalue(27,ILE."Item No.",'',2);
        Inventory.Reference := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",5);
        Inventory."Variant Category" := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",37);
        Inventory.Condition := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",10);
        Inventory.Visibility:= GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",41);
        SalesPrice.RESET;
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Item No.",ILE."Item No.");
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ILE."Variant Code");
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Country/Region Code",'DE');
        IF SalesPrice.FINDLAST THEN
          Inventory."Sales Price":= SalesPrice."Unit Price";
        Inventory.INSERT;
      UNTIL ILE.NEXT=0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertRecordFromBV@301510004();
    VAR
      Inventory@301510002 : Record 50015;
      SalesPrice@301510000 : Record 7002;
    BEGIN
      ILE.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      ILE.RESET;
      ILE.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      ILE.SETFILTER("Remaining Quantity",'>=%1',1);
      IF ILE.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT

        Inventory.INIT;
        Inventory."Entry No":= GetLastEntryNo+1;
        Inventory."Item No":= ILE."Item No.";
        Inventory."Variant code":= ILE."Variant Code";
        Inventory."Location code":=ILE."Location Code";
        Inventory."Company Name":= 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.';
        Inventory.Qty:= ILE."Remaining Quantity";
        Inventory.SerialNo:= ILE."Serial No.";
        Inventory."Entry Type":= ILE."Entry Type";
        Inventory."Vendor No.":= ILE."Source No.";
        Inventory."Differential Taxation Purchase":=ILE."Differential Taxation Purchase";
        ILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)","Cost Amount (Expected)");
        Inventory."Purchase Price":= ILE."Cost Amount (Actual)";
        IF Inventory."Purchase Price"=0.0 THEN BEGIN
          Inventory."Purchase Price Expected":= ILE."Cost Amount (Expected)";
          ILE.CALCFIELDS("Purchase Order No.");
          Inventory."Purchase Order No":= ILE."Purchase Order No.";
        END;  Inventory.Brand := GetAttributevalue(27,ILE."Item No.",'',1);
        Inventory.Model := GetAttributevalue(27,ILE."Item No.",'',2);
        Inventory.Reference := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",5);
        Inventory."Variant Category" := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",37);
        Inventory.Condition := GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",10);
        Inventory.Visibility:= GetAttributevalue(5401,ILE."Item No.",ILE."Variant Code",41);
        SalesPrice.RESET;
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Item No.",ILE."Item No.");
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ILE."Variant Code");
        SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Country/Region Code",'DE');
        IF SalesPrice.FINDLAST THEN
          Inventory."Sales Price":= SalesPrice."Unit Price";
        Inventory.INSERT;
      UNTIL ILE.NEXT=0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetAttributevalue@301510002(TableNo@301510004 : Integer;ItemNo@301510000 : Code[10];VariantCode@301510001 : Code[10];AttributeNumber@301510002 : Integer) Value : Text;
    VAR
      IAVM@301510003 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      IAVM.RESET;
      IAVM.SETRANGE("Table ID",TableNo);
      IAVM.SETRANGE("No.",ItemNo);
      IAVM.SETRANGE("Item Variant Code",VariantCode);
      IAVM.SETRANGE("Item Attribute ID",AttributeNumber);
      IF IAVM.FINDFIRST THEN
        IAVM.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
        Value:= FORMAT(IAVM."Item Attribute Value Text");
      EXIT(Value);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetPurchaselineunitcost@301510003();
    BEGIN
      // 01 13.09.22 SKU ERP-683 ++
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETFILTER("Purchase Order No",'<>%1','');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",InventoryRec."Purchase Order No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          InventoryRec."Unit Cost from Purchase Line":= PurchaseLine."Unit Cost";
          InventoryRec.MODIFY;
       END;
      UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      PurchaseLine.CHANGECOMPANY('Chronext Purchasing B.V.');
      InventoryRec.RESET;
      InventoryRec.SETFILTER("Purchase Order No",'<>%1','');
      IF InventoryRec.FINDSET THEN
      REPEAT
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",InventoryRec."Purchase Order No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",InventoryRec."Item No");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",InventoryRec."Variant code");
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          InventoryRec."Unit Cost from Purchase Line":= PurchaseLine."Unit Cost";
          InventoryRec.MODIFY;
       END;
      UNTIL InventoryRec.NEXT=0;
      // 01 13.09.22 SKU ERP-683 ++
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetInvoice@301510005();
    VAR
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510000 : Record 112;
      PostedSalesInvoice@301510001 : Page 132;
    BEGIN
      SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
      SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",Rec."Last Sales Document");
      IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        CLEAR(PostedSalesInvoice);
        PostedSalesInvoice.SETTABLEVIEW(SalesInvoiceHeader);
        PostedSalesInvoice.RUN;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillVariables@301510006();
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
    BEGIN
      Zertifikat := '';
      IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(5401,Rec."Item No",13,Rec."Variant code",'') THEN BEGIN
        ItemAttributeValueMapping.CALCFIELDS("Item Attribute Value Text");
        Zertifikat := ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value Text";
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 01 09.07.22 SKU ERP-607 new page for Realtime Inventory
      // 01 13.09.22 SKU ERP-683 new field to get Unit Cost of the Purchase Line if it exists.
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Post@4(PostingCodeunitID@1000 : Integer);
    VAR
      PurchaseHeader@1001 : Record 38;
      InstructionMgt@1002 : Codeunit 1330;
      IsScheduledPosting@1003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      SendToPosting(PostingCodeunitID);

      IsScheduledPosting := "Job Queue Status" = "Job Queue Status"::"Scheduled for Posting";
      DocumentIsPosted := (NOT PurchaseHeader.GET("Document Type","No.")) OR IsScheduledPosting;

      IF IsScheduledPosting THEN
        CurrPage.CLOSE;
      CurrPage.UPDATE(FALSE);

      IF PostingCodeunitID <> CODEUNIT::"Purch.-Post (Yes/No)" THEN
        EXIT;

      IF InstructionMgt.IsEnabled(InstructionMgt.ShowPostedConfirmationMessageCode) THEN
        ShowPostedConfirmationMessage;
    END;

    PROCEDURE "Calc. Payed Prepay Amount"@1140001();
    VAR
      "Purch. Inv. Header"@1140000 : Record 122;
      "Purch. Cr. Memo Hdr."@1140001 : Record 124;
      VendLedgEntry@1140002 : Record 25;
    BEGIN

      // 01 21.05.08 HBIE SUPP00512 Integration Vorauskasse: Feld "Prepmt. Amt. Paymnt." fÅllen
      //RestbetrÑge der Vorkassen-Rechnugen und -Gutschriften ermitteln
      "Prepmt. Amt. Paymnt." := 0;

      //Vorkassenrechnungen
      WITH "Purch. Inv. Header" DO BEGIN
        RESET;
        SETCURRENTKEY("Prepayment Order No.","Prepayment Invoice");
        SETRANGE("Prepayment Order No.",Rec."No.");
        SETRANGE("Prepayment Invoice",TRUE);
        IF NOT ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          FINDFIRST;
          REPEAT
            VendLedgEntry.RESET;
            VendLedgEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Vendor No.");
            VendLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.","No.");
            VendLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",VendLedgEntry."Document Type"::Invoice);
            VendLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Vendor No.","Pay-to Vendor No.");
            IF VendLedgEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              VendLedgEntry.CALCFIELDS(Amount);
              VendLedgEntry.CALCFIELDS("Remaining Amount");
              "Prepmt. Amt. Paymnt." := "Prepmt. Amt. Paymnt." -
                                        VendLedgEntry.Amount +
                                        VendLedgEntry."Remaining Amount";
            END;
          UNTIL NEXT = 0;

          //Vorkassengutschriften
          WITH "Purch. Cr. Memo Hdr." DO BEGIN
            RESET;
            SETCURRENTKEY("Prepayment Order No.");
            SETRANGE("Prepayment Order No.",Rec."No.");
            SETRANGE("Prepayment Credit Memo",TRUE);
            IF NOT ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
              FINDFIRST;
              REPEAT
                VendLedgEntry.RESET;
                VendLedgEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.","Document Type","Vendor No.");
                VendLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.","No.");
                VendLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",VendLedgEntry."Document Type"::"Credit Memo");
                VendLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Vendor No.","Pay-to Vendor No.");
                IF VendLedgEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                  VendLedgEntry.CALCFIELDS(Amount);
                  VendLedgEntry.CALCFIELDS("Remaining Amount");
                  "Prepmt. Amt. Paymnt." := "Prepmt. Amt. Paymnt." -
                                            VendLedgEntry.Amount +
                                            VendLedgEntry."Remaining Amount";
                END;
              UNTIL NEXT = 0;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
      // 01 21.05.08 HBIE SUPP00512 Ende
    END;

    PROCEDURE ReleaseDocument@1000000003();

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ValidateShippingOption@8();
    BEGIN
      CASE ShipToOptions OF
        ShipToOptions::"Default (Company Address)",
        ShipToOptions::"Custom Address":
          BEGIN
            VALIDATE("Location Code",'');
            VALIDATE("Sell-to Customer No.",'');
          END;
        ShipToOptions::Location:
          BEGIN
            VALIDATE("Location Code");
            VALIDATE("Sell-to Customer No.",'');
          END;
        ShipToOptions::"Customer Address":
          BEGIN
            VALIDATE("Sell-to Customer No.");
            VALIDATE("Location Code",'');
          END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateCurrentShippingAndPayToOption@36();
    BEGIN
      CASE TRUE OF
        "Sell-to Customer No." <> '':
          ShipToOptions := ShipToOptions::"Customer Address";
        "Location Code" <> '':
          ShipToOptions := ShipToOptions::Location;
        ELSE
          IF ShipToAddressEqualsCompanyShipToAddress THEN
            ShipToOptions := ShipToOptions::"Default (Company Address)"
          ELSE
            ShipToOptions := ShipToOptions::"Custom Address";
      END;

      IF "Pay-to Vendor No." = "Buy-from Vendor No." THEN
        PayToOptions := PayToOptions::"Default (Vendor)"
      ELSE
        PayToOptions := PayToOptions::"Another Vendor";
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE OpenSalesOrderForm@5();
    VAR
      SalesHeader@1000 : Record 36;
      SalesOrder@1001 : Page 42;
      LText001@1119439000 : TextConst 'DEU=Kein Auftrag zu Bestellung %1 Zeile %2 vorhanden.;ENU=Sales Order not available for Purchase Order %1 Line %2.';
    BEGIN
      TESTFIELD("Sales Order No.");
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("No.","Sales Order No.");

      // 01 07.11.11 MJAN SUPP00079 Anzeige Direktlieferung nur wenn Auftrag vorhanden
      SalesHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      IF (NOT SalesHeader.ISEMPTY) THEN BEGIN
      // 01 07.11.11 MJAN SUPP00079 Anzeige Direktlieferung nur wenn Auftrag vorhanden ENDE

        // 01 10.01.06 DPET SUPP00250 Aufruf Form 42 fÅr Nachbearbeitung
        IF (SalesHeader.FIND('-')) AND (SalesHeader."Post Processing") THEN BEGIN
          SalesOrder.SetPostProcessing(TRUE);
          SalesOrder.SETRECORD(SalesHeader);
          SalesOrder.RUNMODAL;
        END ELSE BEGIN
        // 01 10.01.06 DPET SUPP00250 Ende

          SalesOrder.SETTABLEVIEW(SalesHeader);
          SalesOrder.EDITABLE := FALSE;
          SalesOrder.RUN;
        END;

      // 01 07.11.11 MJAN SUPP00079 Anzeige Direktlieferung nur wenn Auftrag vorhanden
      END ELSE
        MESSAGE(LText001,"Document No.","Line No.");
      // 01 07.11.11 MJAN SUPP00079 Anzeige Direktlieferung nur wenn Auftrag vorhanden ENDE
    END;

    PROCEDURE NoLookup@1000000000(VAR Text@1000000000 : Text[1024]) : Boolean;
    VAR
      LookStdText@1000000001 : Record 7;
      LookGLAccount@1000000002 : Record 15;
      LookItem@1000000003 : Record 27;
      LookResource@1000000004 : Record 156;
      LookFixedAsset@1000000005 : Record 5600;
      LookItemCharge@1000000006 : Record 5800;
      PurchaseHeader2@1000000007 : Record 38;
      SystemMgtSetup@1000000008 : Record 5105000;
      ItemLookUpForm@1000000009 : Page 31;
    BEGIN
      // 01 30.07.04 MHEL CLUP Bei Lookup nur die Artikel des aktuellen Kreditoren anzeigen
      CASE Type OF
        Type::" " : BEGIN
          LookStdText.INIT;
          LookStdText.Code := COPYSTR(Text,1,MAXSTRLEN(LookStdText.Code));
          IF LookStdText.FIND('=><') THEN;
          IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,LookStdText) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
            Text := LookStdText.Code;
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
        Type::"G/L Account" : BEGIN
          LookGLAccount.INIT;
          LookGLAccount."No." := COPYSTR(Text,1,MAXSTRLEN(LookGLAccount."No."));
          IF LookGLAccount.FIND('=><') THEN;
          IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,LookGLAccount) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
            Text := LookGLAccount."No.";
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
        Type::Item : BEGIN
          SystemMgtSetup.GET;
          PurchaseHeader2.GET("Document Type","Document No.");
          LookItem.INIT;
          LookItem.SETCURRENTKEY("Vendor No.");
          LookItem.SETRANGE("Vendor No.",PurchaseHeader2."Buy-from Vendor No.");
          LookItem.SETFILTER("No.",Text + '*');
          LookItem.SETFILTER("Disposition Status",SystemMgtSetup."Requisition Dispostatus Filter");
          IF NOT LookItem.FIND('=><') THEN
            LookItem.RESET;
            LookItem.SETFILTER("No.",Text + '*');
            IF LookItem.FIND('=><') THEN;
          LookItem.SETRANGE("No.");
          IF LookItem.GETFILTER("Vendor No.") = '' THEN
            LookItem.SETFILTER("Vendor No.",'%1|<>%1','');
          //ItemLookUpForm.SetDispoFieldsVisible := TRUE;
          ItemLookUpForm.SETTABLEVIEW(LookItem);
          ItemLookUpForm.LOOKUPMODE := TRUE;
          ItemLookUpForm.SETRECORD(LookItem);
          IF ItemLookUpForm.RUNMODAL = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
            ItemLookUpForm.GETRECORD(LookItem);
            //ItemLookUpForm.SetDispoFieldsVisible := FALSE;
            Text := LookItem."No.";
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE BEGIN
            //ItemLookUpForm.SetDispoFieldsVisible := FALSE;
            EXIT(FALSE);
          END;
        END;
        {
        Type::Resource : BEGIN
          LookResource.INIT;
          LookResource."No." := COPYSTR(Text,1,MAXSTRLEN(LookResource."No."));
          IF LookResource.FIND('=><') THEN;
          IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,LookResource) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
            Text := LookResource."No.";
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
        }
        Type::"Fixed Asset" : BEGIN
          LookFixedAsset.INIT;
          LookFixedAsset."No." := COPYSTR(Text,1,MAXSTRLEN(LookFixedAsset."No."));
          IF LookFixedAsset.FIND('=><') THEN;
          IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,LookFixedAsset) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
            Text := LookFixedAsset."No.";
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
        Type::"Charge (Item)" : BEGIN
          LookItemCharge.INIT;
          LookItemCharge."No." := COPYSTR(Text,1,MAXSTRLEN(LookItemCharge."No."));
          IF LookItemCharge.FIND('=><') THEN;
          IF PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,LookItemCharge) = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
            Text := LookItemCharge."No.";
            EXIT(TRUE);
          END ELSE
            EXIT(FALSE);
        END;
      END;
      // 01 30.07.04 MHEL CLUP Ende
    END;

    PROCEDURE ShowPriceBuild@5104681();
    VAR
      PurchHeader@1140002 : Record 38;
      "Purchase Price Buffer"@1140000 : Record 5104681;
      TempPurchaseLine@1140003 : TEMPORARY Record 39;
      PurchaseLine3@1000000001 : Record 39;
      TempPurchaseLine2@1000000000 : TEMPORARY Record 39;
      PurchPriceCalcMgt@1140001 : Codeunit 7010;
      ConditionedQuantity@1140004 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      // 01 04.06.08 KMAR VBS000026 Aufruf EK-Preis-Matrix und EK-Preis-Zusammensetzung, Einkaufskonditionen
      IF Type = Type::Item THEN BEGIN
        PurchHeader.GET("Document Type","Document No.");

        // Naturalrabatt merken
        PurchaseLine3.SETRANGE("Document Type","Document Type");
        PurchaseLine3.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
        PurchaseLine3.SETFILTER("Natural Discount from Line No.",'<>%1',0);
        IF PurchaseLine3.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            TempPurchaseLine2 := PurchaseLine3;
            TempPurchaseLine2.INSERT;
          UNTIL PurchaseLine3.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        PurchPriceCalcMgt.FindConditionedLines(PurchHeader,Rec);
        PurchPriceCalcMgt.GetPurchaseLines(TempPurchaseLine);
        IF TempPurchaseLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
          ConditionedQuantity := 0;
          REPEAT
            IF "Line No." <> TempPurchaseLine."Line No." THEN
              ConditionedQuantity += ABS(TempPurchaseLine.Quantity)
            ELSE
              ConditionedQuantity += ABS(Quantity);
          UNTIL TempPurchaseLine.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        // Naturalrabatt zurÅckschreiben
        IF TempPurchaseLine2.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            PurchaseLine3 := TempPurchaseLine2;
            PurchaseLine3.INSERT;
          UNTIL TempPurchaseLine2.NEXT = 0;
        END;

        "Purchase Price Buffer".CalcPurchasePrice(
          "Buy-from Vendor No.",
          "No.",
          "Variant Code",
          "Unit of Measure Code",
          "Currency Code",
          ConditionedQuantity,
          "Order Date");
      END;
      // 01 04.06.08 KMAR VBS000026 Aufruf EK-Preis-Matrix und EK-Preis-Zusammensetzung, Einkaufskonditionen Ende
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SachktoBetrag@301510000(pKtoNr@301510001 : Code[20];pShow@301510002 : Boolean) rDec : Decimal;
    VAR
      GLEntry@301510000 : Record 17;
    BEGIN

      GLEntry.RESET;
      GLEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.","Document No.");
      GLEntry.SETRANGE("Posting Date","Posting Date");
      IF pKtoNr = 'SONST' THEN
        GLEntry.SETFILTER("G/L Account No.",STRSUBSTNO('<>%1&<>%2&<>%3&<>%4&<>%5&<>%6',
                                                       '42510','44091','44092','44093','44094','38000'))
      ELSE
        GLEntry.SETRANGE("G/L Account No.",pKtoNr);
      GLEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type",GLEntry."Document Type"::Invoice);
      GLEntry.SETRANGE("Document Line No.","Line No.");

      IF pShow THEN BEGIN
        PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,GLEntry);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        GLEntry.CALCSUMS(Amount);
        rDec := GLEntry.Amount;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

                                         IF g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Currency Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
                                             g_recCurrExcRate.RESET;
                                             g_recCurrExcRate.SETRANGE("Currency Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Currency Code");
                                             IF g_recCurrExcRate.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
                                                 g_recCurrExcRate.GetLastestExchangeRate(g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Currency Code",g_dateExchangeRateDate,g_decExchangeRateAmt);
                                                 g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
                                                 g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Recom. Retail Price" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Recom. Retail Price" * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
                                                 g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Strike Price" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Strike Price" * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
                                                 g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Exchange Rate Amount" := 1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt;
                                                 g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Exchange Rate Date" := g_dateExchangeRateDate;
                                             END;
                                         END
                                         ELSE BEGIN
                                           g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price";
                                           g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Recom. Retail Price" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Recom. Retail Price";
                                           g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Strike Price" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Strike Price";
                                         END;
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Starting Date" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Starting Date";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Starting Time" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Starting Time";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Ending Date" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Ending Date";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Ending Time" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Ending Time";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Reason Code" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Reason Code";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2.Comment := g_recSalesPriceCheck.Comment;
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2.Validated := TRUE;
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Approved By" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Approved By";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Accept New Setup" := g_recSalesPriceCheck."Accept New Setup";
                                         g_recSalesPriceCheck2.INSERT(TRUE);
                                       UNTIL g_recCountry.NEXT = 0;
                                     END;
                                     UpdateSalesPriceCheck.GET(g_recSalesPriceCheck."Item No.",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Variant Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Currency Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Country Code");

                                   UNTIL g_recSalesPriceCheck.NEXT = 0;
                                 END;

                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price From Cat 1");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price To Cat 1");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price From Cat 2");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price To Cat 2");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price From Cat 3");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price To Cat 3");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("Cat 1 Non Stock %");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("Cat 2 Non Stock %");
                                 g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("Cat 3 Non Stock %");

                                 fnCalcNonStockPrice(g_recGenSPSetup."If Stock Price From Cat 1",g_recGenSPSetup."If Stock Price To Cat 1",g_recGenSPSetup."Cat 1 Non Stock %");
                                 fnCalcNonStockPrice(g_recGenSPSetup."If Stock Price From Cat 2",g_recGenSPSetup."If Stock Price To Cat 2",g_recGenSPSetup."Cat 2 Non Stock %");
                                 fnCalcNonStockPrice(g_recGenSPSetup."If Stock Price From Cat 3",g_recGenSPSetup."If Stock Price To Cat 3",g_recGenSPSetup."Cat 3 Non Stock %");

      g_decProfit@301510009 : Decimal;

      TXT004@301510012 : TextConst 'ENU=New Non Stock Price %1 is less than New Stock Price %2';

    LOCAL PROCEDURE fnValidate@301510000();
    BEGIN
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE(Validated,FALSE);
      IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
         ProgressWindow.OPEN('Validating Sales Price @1@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@');
         TotalCount := COUNT;
         REPEAT
          //SLEEP(250);
          //check margin
          {
          g_recGenSPSetup.GET;
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("Minimum Margin %");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price From Cat 1");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price To Cat 1");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price From Cat 2");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price To Cat 2");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price From Cat 3");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("If Stock Price To Cat 3");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("Stock Price Threshold %");
          g_recGenSPSetup.TESTFIELD("Non Stock Price Threshold %");
           }
           CLEAR(g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark);
           CLEAR(g_decStockPricePercentFromPrev);
           CLEAR(g_decNonStockPricePercentFromPrev);

           g_recSP.RESET;
           g_recSP.SETRANGE("Item No.",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Item No.");
           g_recSP.SETRANGE("Variant Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Variant Code");
           g_recSP.SETRANGE("Currency Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Currency Code");
           g_recSP.SETRANGE("Country/Region Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Country Code");
           g_recSP.SETRANGE("Starting Date",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Starting Date");
           IF g_recSP.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              g_recSalesPriceCheck."Old Stock Price" := g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)";
              IF g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" < g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)" THEN BEGIN
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT001,ROUND(((g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)" - g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price")/g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)") * 100,0.01,'='),g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)");
              END;
              {IF g_recSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price" < g_recSP."Non Stock Price" THEN BEGIN
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT002,ROUND(((g_recSP."Non Stock Price" - g_recSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price")/g_recSP."Non Stock Price") * 100,0.01,'='),g_recSP."Non Stock Price");
              END;
              IF g_recSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price" < g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" THEN BEGIN
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT004,g_recSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price");
              END;
              }
              g_decStockPricePercentFromPrev := ROUND(((g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" - g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)")/g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)") * 100,0.01,'=');
              IF (g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" > g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)") AND (g_decStockPricePercentFromPrev > g_recGenSPSetup."Stock Price Threshold %") THEN BEGIN
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT007,g_decStockPricePercentFromPrev,g_recSP."Unit Price (LCY)");
              END;
              //g_decNonStockPricePercentFromPrev := ROUND(((g_recSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price" - g_recSP."Non Stock Price")/g_recSP."Non Stock Price") * 100,0.01,'=');
              {IF (g_recSalesPriceCheck."Non Stock Price" > g_recSP."Non Stock Price") AND (g_decNonStockPricePercentFromPrev > g_recGenSPSetup."Non Stock Price Threshold %") THEN BEGIN
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT008,g_decNonStockPricePercentFromPrev,g_recSP."Non Stock Price");
              END;}
           END;

           g_decSPExclVAT := 0;
           g_decProfit := 0;
           g_decProfitPercent := 0;

           g_recILE.RESET;
           g_recILE.SETRANGE("Item No.",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Item No.");
           g_recILE.SETRANGE("Variant Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Variant Code");
           g_recILE.SETRANGE("Invoiced Quantity",1);
           g_recILE.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
           IF g_recILE.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
              g_recILE.CALCFIELDS("Cost Amount (Actual)");
              IF NOT g_recILE."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN BEGIN
                g_decSPExclVAT := (g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" * 100) / 119;
                g_decProfit := g_decSPExclVAT - g_recILE."Cost Amount (Actual)";
                g_decProfitPercent := ROUND((g_decProfit / g_decSPExclVAT) * 100,0.01,'=');
              END
              ELSE BEGIN
                g_decProfit := ((g_recSalesPriceCheck."Stock Price" - g_recILE."Cost Amount (Actual)") * 100) / 119;
                g_decProfitPercent := ROUND((g_decProfit / (g_recILE."Cost Amount (Actual)"+g_decProfit) * 100),0.01,'=');
              END;
              IF (g_decProfitPercent < g_recGenSPSetup."Minimum Margin %") THEN BEGIN
                g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT003,g_decProfitPercent,g_recGenSPSetup."Minimum Margin %");
              END;
           END;

           //check curr code
           g_recCountry.RESET;
           g_recCountry.SETRANGE(Code,g_recSalesPriceCheck."Country Code");
           g_recCountry.SETRANGE("Sales Price Activated",TRUE);
           IF g_recCountry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              IF g_recSalesPriceCheck."Currency Code" <> g_recCountry."Sales Price Currency Code" THEN
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT005,g_recSalesPriceCheck."Currency Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Country Code");
           END;

           //check start date & end date
           IF (g_recSalesPriceCheck."Starting Date" > g_recSalesPriceCheck."Ending Date") AND (g_recSalesPriceCheck."Ending Date" <> 0D) THEN
               g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := STRSUBSTNO(TXT006,g_recSalesPriceCheck."Starting Date",g_recSalesPriceCheck."Ending Date");

           IF g_recSalesPriceCheck."Accept New Setup" = TRUE THEN BEGIN
              g_recSalesPriceCheck.Remark := '';
           END;

           g_recSalesPriceCheck.Validated := TRUE;

           g_recSalesPriceCheck.MODIFY;
           CountToValidate += 1;
           ProgressWindow.UPDATE(1,ROUND(CountToValidate / TotalCount * 10000,1));
         UNTIL g_recSalesPriceCheck.NEXT = 0;
         ProgressWindow.CLOSE;
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE fnCalcNonStockPrice@301510001(p_decStockPriceFrom@301510000 : Decimal;p_decStockPriceTo@301510001 : Decimal;p_decNonStockPercent@301510002 : Decimal);
    BEGIN
      g_recSalesPriceCheck2.RESET;
      g_recSalesPriceCheck2.SETRANGE("Non Stock Price",0);
      g_recSalesPriceCheck2.SETFILTER("Stock Price",'%1..%2',p_decStockPriceFrom,p_decStockPriceTo);
      IF g_recSalesPriceCheck2.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
         REPEAT
           IF g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Currency Code" <> '' THEN BEGIN
              g_recCurrExcRate.RESET;
              g_recCurrExcRate.SETRANGE("Currency Code",g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Currency Code");
              IF g_recCurrExcRate.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
                 g_recCurrExcRate.GetLastestExchangeRate(g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Currency Code",g_dateExchangeRateDate,g_decExchangeRateAmt);
                 //g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Non Stock Price" := (g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" +
                 //                                       (g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" * p_decNonStockPercent / 100)) * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
                 g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Non Stock Price" := ((g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" / (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt)) +
                                                        ((g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" / (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt)) * p_decNonStockPercent / 100)) * (1 / g_decExchangeRateAmt);
              END
           END ELSE BEGIN
              g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Non Stock Price" :=
              g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" + (g_recSalesPriceCheck2."Stock Price" * p_decNonStockPercent / 100);
           END;
           g_recSalesPriceCheck2.MODIFY;
         UNTIL g_recSalesPriceCheck2.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckEntries@301510002(Funtion@301510000 : Integer);
    BEGIN

      IF (TRUE)THEN BEGIN
      EXIT;
      END;
      IF (Funtion = 1)THEN BEGIN
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
      //g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETFILTER("Country Code",'%1','DE');
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE("Accept New Setup",FALSE);
      IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('Nothing to process');
      END;
      IF (Funtion = 2)THEN BEGIN
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
      //g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETFILTER("Country Code",'%1','DE');
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE("Accept New Setup",FALSE);
      IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDFIRST THEN
        //ERROR('Nothing to process');
        EXIT
      END;

      IF (Funtion = 3)THEN BEGIN
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
      //g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETFILTER("Country Code",'%1','DE');
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE("Accept New Setup",FALSE);
      IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('Nothing to process');
      END;

      IF (Funtion = 3) OR (Funtion = 4)THEN BEGIN
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETFILTER("Country Code",'%1','DE');
      g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE(Validated,FALSE);
      IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR('Nothing to process');
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckDEPrice@301510003();
    BEGIN
      IF NonDEPrice THEN BEGIN
        g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
        g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETFILTER("Country Code",'%1','DE');
        //g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE(Validated,FALSE);
        IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDFIRST THEN
           ERROR('DE price not allowed');
      END ELSE BEGIN
        g_recSalesPriceCheck.RESET;
        g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETFILTER("Country Code",'<>%1','DE');
        //g_recSalesPriceCheck.SETRANGE(Validated,FALSE);
        IF g_recSalesPriceCheck.FINDFIRST THEN
           ERROR('Non DE price not allowed');
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 01 16.02.22 VMO ERP-490 new page
      // 01 23.03.22 SKU ERP-517 added code to trasfer the data to archive table
    }
    END.
  }

    VAR
      rec_ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetVariables@301510000();
    BEGIN
      rec_ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      rec_ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",Rec."Serial No.");
      IF rec_ItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        g_SerialNo := rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.";
        g_LocationCode := rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code";
        g_BinCode := FindBinCode;
        g_ReservedOrderNo := FindReservation;
        g_PictureCount := FindPicture;
        g_TransactionSecurity := FindTransactionSecurity;
        FindPurchaseOrder;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindBinCode@301510003() : Code[20];
    VAR
      BinContent@301510000 : Record 7302;
    BEGIN
      IF  g_LocationCode = 'HL' THEN BEGIN
        BinContent.RESET;
        BinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        BinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        BinContent.SETAUTOCALCFIELDS(Quantity);
        BinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
        IF BinContent.FINDFIRST THEN
          EXIT(BinContent."Bin Code")
        ELSE
          EXIT('');
      END ELSE
        EXIT('');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindReservation@301510001() : Code[20];
    VAR
      ReservationEntry@301510000 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      ReservationEntry.RESET;
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",g_SerialNo);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",37);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,FALSE);
      IF ReservationEntry.FINDLAST THEN
        EXIT(ReservationEntry."Source ID")
      ELSE
        EXIT('');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindPicture@301510002() : Integer;
    VAR
      ItemPictureMapping@301510000 : Record 85002;
    BEGIN
      ItemPictureMapping.RESET;
      ItemPictureMapping.SETRANGE("Item No.",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
      ItemPictureMapping.SETRANGE("Variant Code",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
      IF ItemPictureMapping.FINDSET THEN
        EXIT(ItemPictureMapping.COUNT)
      ELSE
        EXIT(0);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindTransactionSecurity@301510006() : Text;
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
    BEGIN
      IF g_ReservedOrderNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        IF SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,g_ReservedOrderNo) THEN BEGIN
          SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Status Address Check","Status Approve Order");
          IF ((SalesHeader."Status Address Check" IN [SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Approved,SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::Ignore,SalesHeader."Status Address Check"::"No Differences"]) AND
              (SalesHeader."Status Approve Order" = SalesHeader."Status Approve Order"::Approved)) THEN
            EXIT('Confirmed')
          ELSE
          EXIT('Not Confirmed');
        END ELSE
          EXIT('');
      END ELSE
        EXIT('');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindPurchaseOrder@301510009();
    VAR
      PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510001 : Record 39;
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      g_PurchaseReturnOrderNo := '';
      g_PurchaseReturnOrderPosted := '';

      PurchaseLine.RESET;
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        g_PurchaseReturnOrderNo := PurchaseLine."Document No.";
        IF PurchaseLine."Return Qty. Shipped" > 0 THEN
          g_PurchaseReturnOrderPosted := 'True'
        ELSE
          g_PurchaseReturnOrderPosted := 'False';
      END ELSE BEGIN
        ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",rec_ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Entry Type",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry Type"::Purchase);
        ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,FALSE);
        IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
          g_PurchaseReturnOrderNo := ItemLedgerEntry."Document No.";
          g_PurchaseReturnOrderPosted := 'True';
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreateShipment@301510000() : Boolean;
    VAR
      Packinghead@301510000 : Record 5104639;
      packingLine@301510001 : Record 5104640;
      DocInfo@301510002 : Record 5104676;
      Cominfo@301510003 : Record 79;
      TransferLine@301510004 : Record 5741;
    BEGIN
      {Cominfo.GET;
      Packinghead.INIT;
      Packinghead."Document Type":= Packinghead."Document Type"::"Transfer Order";
      Packinghead."Document No.":= "No.";
      Packinghead."Line No.":= 20000;
      Packinghead."Filling Weight":= 1.23;
      Packinghead.Length:= 20;
      Packinghead.Width:= 20;
      Packinghead.Height:=20;
      Packinghead."Upper Weight Limit Package":= 25;
      Packinghead."Shipping Agent Code":= 'FEDEX';
      Packinghead."Package Group Priority":= 99;
      Packinghead."System Value No. Package Size":= 72103;
      Packinghead."Package Size Code":= 'FREI';
      Packinghead."Remaining Filling Weight":= 25;
      Packinghead."Item Type":= Packinghead."Item Type"::"Smaller Part";
      Packinghead."Country Code":= 'DE';
      //Packinghead."Payment Method Code":= Rec.
      Packinghead."Source Type":= 5740;
      Packinghead."Source No.":= "No.";
      Packinghead."Post Code (Shipment)":= Cominfo."Post Code";
      Packinghead."Insert from":= USERID;
      Packinghead."Packing Date":=TODAY;
      Packinghead."Packing Time":=TIME;
      Packinghead."Insert Date":= TODAY;
      Packinghead."Insert Time":= TIME;
      //Packinghead."Customer No.":= "Buy-from Vendor No.";
      //Packinghead."Order Date":=
      Packinghead.INSERT;
      //TransferLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",Rec."Document Type");
      TransferLine.SETRANGE("Document No.","No.");
      IF TransferLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
       //g_recPL.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
      packingLine.INIT;
      packingLine."Document Type":=  Packinghead."Document Type";
      packingLine."Document No.":= Packinghead."Document No.";
      packingLine."Entry No.":= 1;
      packingLine."Item No.":= TransferLine."Item No.";
      packingLine."Variant Code":= TransferLine."Variant Code";
      packingLine."Shipping Agent Code":= Packinghead."Shipping Agent Code";
      packingLine."Item Quantity":= 1;
      packingLine."Unit of Measure Code":='STCK';
      packingLine."System Value No. Item Comptbl.":= 72102;
      packingLine."System Value No. Del.Cost Lmt.":= 72102;
      packingLine."Source Item Amount (LCY)":= 550;
      packingLine."Source No.":= "No.";
      packingLine."Source Type":= 5740;
      packingLine."Source Subtype":=1;
      packingLine.INSERT;
      END ELSE
      ERROR
      ('No line found');
      FedExMgt.SetTransferOrder(TRUE,Rec);
      // 01 23.03.23 KEGG MSD-22857 PDF printer for Packet Label
      FedExMgt.SetImageTypePDF(TRUE);
      // 01 23.03.23 KEGG MSD-22857 PDF printer for Packet Label ENDE
      FedExMgt.GetLabelFromWebservice(Packinghead);
      // 01 23.03.23 KEGG MSD-22857 PDF printer for Packet Label
      FedExMgt.SetImageTypePDF(FALSE);
      // 01 23.03.23 KEGG MSD-22857 PDF printer for Packet Label ENDE
      }
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // NF 12.03.14 KKAA BDCECHT Field 5104850: "No Whse. Shpt."
      // NF 12.03.14 KKAA BDCECHT Field 5104850: "No Pick Orders"
      // NF 12.03.14 KKAA BDCECHT Field 5104850: "No Reg. Pick Orders"
      // 01 17.05.16 KKOE 10062461 CU6
      // 01 25.08.16 MBLA 10064315 Merged by AMU: Implementierung NAV 2016 - CU10
    }
    END.
  }

    PROCEDURE CalcPositions@1000000000(CalcType@1000000000 : 'All,Recorded,%') : Integer;
    VAR
      PhysRecordLines@1000000001 : Record 5005353;
      ReturnValue@1000000002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      PhysRecordLines.RESET;
      PhysRecordLines.SETRANGE("Order No.","Order No.");
      PhysRecordLines.SETRANGE("Recording No.","Recording No.");
      CASE CalcType OF
        CalcType::All: ;
        CalcType::Recorded: PhysRecordLines.SETRANGE(Recorded,TRUE);
        CalcType::"%": ;
      END;
      CASE CalcType OF
        CalcType::All: ReturnValue := PhysRecordLines.COUNT;
        CalcType::Recorded: ReturnValue := PhysRecordLines.COUNT;
        CalcType::"%":
          BEGIN
            ReturnValue := PhysRecordLines.COUNT;
            IF ReturnValue > 0 THEN BEGIN
              PhysRecordLines.SETRANGE(Recorded,TRUE);
              ReturnValue := ROUND((PhysRecordLines.COUNT / ReturnValue) * 100,1,'=');
            END;
          END;
      END;
      EXIT(ReturnValue);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GoSearch@301480009();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301480001 : Record 32;
      lItemLedgerEntry2@301510001 : Record 32;
      BinContent@301480000 : Record 7302;
      lDiVAItemTrackingMgt@301480002 : Codeunit 5104818;
      lLogisticMgtChronext@301490000 : Codeunit 85200;
      UOM@301480005 : Code[10];
      ReservationEntry@301510002 : Record 337;
      lLocation@301510003 : Record 14;
      lItemAttributeValueMapping@301480003 : Record 7505;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301510004 : Record 5767;
      lWhseItemTrackingLine@301490001 : Record 6550;
    BEGIN
      Location := '';
      BinCode := '';
      ItemNo := '';
      OrderNo := '';

      IF Rec.Code = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.");
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",Rec.Code);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        Location := ItemLedgerEntry."Location Code";
        ItemNo := ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.";
        VariantCode := ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code";
        IF VariantCode <> '' THEN BEGIN
          FindRes(ItemNo,VariantCode,Rec.Code);
          BinContent.RESET;
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Location Code",Location);
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          BinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",VariantCode);
          BinContent.SETFILTER("Serial No. Filter",Rec.Code);
          BinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
          IF NOT BinContent.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
            IF BinContent.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
              BinCode := BinContent."Bin Code";
              IF BinCode = 'EINGHL' THEN BEGIN
                WarehouseActivityLine.RESET;
                WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type"::"Put-away");
                WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place);
                WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Serial No.",Rec.Code);
                WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Qty. to Handle",1);
                IF WarehouseActivityLine.FINDFIRST THEN
                  BinCode := COPYSTR(BinCode + '/' + WarehouseActivityLine."Bin Code",1,20);
              END;
            END;
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindRes@301510001(pItemNo@301510000 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301510001 : Code[20];pSerialNo@301510002 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      ReservationEntry@301510003 : Record 337;
    BEGIN
      ReservationEntry.RESET;
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemNo);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pVariantCode);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",Rec.Code);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,FALSE);
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Type",DATABASE::"Sales Line");
      ReservationEntry.SETRANGE("Source Subtype",1);
      IF ReservationEntry.FINDFIRST THEN
        OrderNo := ReservationEntry."Source ID";
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetSource@301510002(pItemLedgerEntry@301510005 : Record 32) : Text;
    VAR
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510000 : Record 50030;
      PurchaseLine@301510001 : Record 39;
      PurchInvLine@301510002 : Record 123;
      SellWatchVendorInfo@301510003 : Record 50012;
      PurchInvHeader@301510004 : Record 122;
    BEGIN
      PurchaseLine.RESET;
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",pItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
      PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
      IF PurchaseLine.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
        SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
        SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",PurchaseLine."Document No.");
        IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          EXIT(SellWatchVendorInfo.VendorNo);
        END;
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PurchInvLine.RESET;
        PurchInvLine.SETRANGE("No.",pItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
        PurchInvLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
        IF PurchInvLine.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
          PurchInvHeader.GET(PurchInvLine."Document No.");
          SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
          SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE("PO Number",PurchInvHeader."Order No.");
          IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            EXIT(SellWatchVendorInfo.VendorNo);
          END;
        END;
      END;
      EXIT('');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillData@301510000();
    VAR
      ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;
      Vendor@301510001 : Record 23;
    BEGIN
      ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Item No.",'<>%1','BOX');
      ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      IF ItemLedgerEntry.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
        REPEAT
          VendorNo := GetSource(ItemLedgerEntry);
          IF VendorNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
            Vendor.GET(VendorNo);
            Rec.INIT;
            Rec.TRANSFERFIELDS(ItemLedgerEntry);
            Rec.Description := Vendor.Name;
            Rec."Source No." := Vendor."No.";
            Rec.INSERT;
          END;
        UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT = 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetWorkshopInvoice@301510004(ItemLedgerEntry@301510003 : Record 32);
    VAR
      Vendor@301510000 : Record 23;
      Customer@301510001 : Record 18;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510002 : Record 112;
      VendorNo@301510004 : Code[20];
      SellWatchVendorInfo@301510005 : Record 50012;
      SalesInvoiceLine@301510006 : Record 113;
    BEGIN
      WorkShopInvoice := 0;

      IF Vendor.GET(ItemLedgerEntry."Source No.") THEN BEGIN
        EMail := Vendor."E-Mail";
        Address := Vendor.Address;
        PostCode := Vendor."Post Code";
        City := Vendor.City;
        CountryRegion := Vendor."Country/Region Code";
        PhoneNumber := Vendor."Phone No.";
        SellWatchVendorInfo.RESET;
        SellWatchVendorInfo.SETRANGE(VendorNo,Vendor."No.");
        IF SellWatchVendorInfo.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
          srid := SellWatchVendorInfo.SRid;
          IBAN := SellWatchVendorInfo.IBAN;
        END;
        FindOrderNo(ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code",gPurchaseOrderNo);
        Customer.RESET;
        Customer.SETRANGE(Name,Vendor.Name);
        IF Customer.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
          REPEAT
            SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("Sell-to Customer No.",Customer."No.");
            SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",'');
            IF SalesInvoiceHeader.FINDSET THEN BEGIN
              REPEAT
                SalesInvoiceLine.RESET;
                SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesInvoiceHeader."No.");
                SalesInvoiceLine.SETFILTER(Description,'%1','*'+gPurchaseOrderNo+'*');
                IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDSET THEN
                  WorkShopInvoice += SalesInvoiceLine."Amount Including VAT"
                ELSE BEGIN
                  SalesInvoiceLine.SETRANGE(Description);
                  IF SalesInvoiceLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
                    IF SalesInvoiceLine.Description = '' THEN BEGIN
                      IF SalesInvoiceHeader."Posting Date" < 010526D THEN BEGIN
                        SalesInvoiceHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
                        {WorkShopInvoice += SalesInvoiceHeader."Amount Including VAT";}
                      END;
                    END;
                  END;
                END;
              UNTIL SalesInvoiceHeader.NEXT = 0;
            END;
          UNTIL Customer.NEXT = 0;
        END;

      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetBinCode@301510001(ItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32);
    VAR
      BinContent@301510001 : Record 7302;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301510002 : Record 5767;
    BEGIN
      BinCode := '';
      BinContent.RESET;
      BinContent.SETRANGE("Location Code",'HL');
      BinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Item No.");
      BinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code");
      BinContent.SETRANGE("Unit of Measure Code",ItemLedgerEntry."Unit of Measure Code");
      BinContent.SETFILTER("Serial No. Filter",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
      BinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
      IF NOT BinContent.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        IF BinContent.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          BinCode := BinContent."Bin Code";
          IF BinCode = 'EINGHL' THEN BEGIN
            WarehouseActivityLine.RESET;
            WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type"::"Put-away");
            WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place);
            WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Serial No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
            WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Qty. to Handle",1);
            IF WarehouseActivityLine.FINDFIRST THEN
              BinCode := COPYSTR(BinCode + '/' + WarehouseActivityLine."Bin Code",1,20)
          END;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindOrderNo@301510005(ItemNo@301510000 : Code[20];VariantCode@301510001 : Code[20];VAR PurchaseOrderNo@301510002 : Code[20]);
    VAR
      PurchInvLine@301510003 : Record 123;
      PurchInvHeader@301510004 : Record 122;
      PurchaseHeader@301510005 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510006 : Record 39;
      VendorLedgerEntry@301510007 : Record 25;
    BEGIN
      PurchInvLine.RESET;
      PurchInvLine.SETRANGE(PurchInvLine."No.",ItemNo);
      PurchInvLine.SETRANGE(PurchInvLine."Variant Code","Variant Code");
      IF PurchInvLine.FINDLAST THEN
        PurchaseOrderNo := PurchInvHeader."Order No."
      ELSE BEGIN
        PurchaseLine.RESET;
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseLine."Document Type"::Order);
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("No.",ItemNo);
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",VariantCode);

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateCosts@301510000();
    VAR
      NuveiManagement@301510000 : Codeunit 50041;
      bool@301510001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      VendorAmount := 0;
      ChronextAmount := 0;

      VendorAmount := NuveiManagement.FindCosts_Inv_SalesOrder(Rec."No.",Rec."External Document No.",bool,OrderNo,InvoiceNo,VendorNo);

      IF VendorAmount = 0 THEN
        ChronextAmount := Rec."Amount Including VAT"
      ELSE
        ChronextAmount := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - VendorAmount;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalculateAmounts@301510001(pType@301510000 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      CASE pType OF
        1 : "Nuvei Chronext Comission" := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - "Nuvei Vendor Amount";
        2 : "Nuvei Vendor Amount" := Rec."Amount Including VAT" - "Nuvei Chronext Comission";
      END;
      Rec.MODIFY;
    END;

    PROCEDURE SetVisible@301510002(Type@301510000 : Integer);
    BEGIN
      CASE Type OF
        1 : BEGIN
          gVisible1 := TRUE;
          gVisible2 := TRUE;
        END;
        2 : BEGIN
          gVisible1 := TRUE;
          gVisible2 := FALSE;
        END;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.

    BEGIN

      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::Order);
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Contact No.","No.");
      NoOfOrders := PurchaseHeader.COUNT;

      PurchInvHeader.RESET;
      PurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Contact No.","No.");
      NoOfInvoices := PurchInvHeader.COUNT;

      PurchRcptHeader.RESET;
      PurchRcptHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Contact No.","No.");
      NoOfPostedShipments := PurchRcptHeader.COUNT;

      PurchaseHeader.RESET;
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Document Type",PurchaseHeader."Document Type"::"Return Order");
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Buy-from Contact No.","No.");
      NoofReturns := PurchaseHeader.COUNT;

      PurchCrMemoHdr.RESET;
      PurchCrMemoHdr.SETRANGE("Buy-from Contact No.","No.");
      NoofReturns := PurchCrMemoHdr.COUNT;
    END;

    END.
