    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdateBalance@1();
    VAR
      TempGenJourLine@1150001 : Record 81;
      TmpLineNo@1150000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      GenJnlManagement.CalcBalance(
        Rec,xRec,Balance,TotalBalance,ShowBalance,ShowTotalBalance);
      BalanceVisible := ShowBalance;
      TotalBalanceVisible := ShowTotalBalance;

      TotalPayAmount := 0;
      TempGenJourLine.COPY(Rec);

      IF "Line No." = 0 THEN
        TmpLineNo := xRec."Line No."
      ELSE
        TmpLineNo := "Line No.";

      TempGenJourLine.MARKEDONLY(TRUE);
      IF TempGenJourLine.FIND('-') THEN
        REPEAT
          TotalBalance := TotalBalance - TempGenJourLine."Balance (LCY)";
          IF TempGenJourLine."Line No." <= TmpLineNo THEN
            Balance := Balance - TempGenJourLine."Balance (LCY)";
          IF (TempGenJourLine."Document Type" = TempGenJourLine."Document Type"::Payment) AND
             (TempGenJourLine."Account Type" = TempGenJourLine."Account Type"::Customer)
          THEN
            TotalPayAmount := TotalPayAmount - -TempGenJourLine."Amount (LCY)";
        UNTIL TempGenJourLine.NEXT = 0;
      TempGenJourLine.MARKEDONLY(FALSE);

      // Reset Display
      IF NOT TempGenJourLine.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
        Balance := 0;
        TotalBalance := 0;
      END;

      TempGenJourLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Journal Template Name","Journal Batch Name","Account Type","Document Type");
      TempGenJourLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",TempGenJourLine."Document Type"::Payment);
      TempGenJourLine.SETRANGE("Account Type",TempGenJourLine."Account Type"::Customer);
      IF TempGenJourLine.CALCSUMS("Amount (LCY)") THEN BEGIN
        TotalPayAmount := TotalPayAmount + -TempGenJourLine."Amount (LCY)";
        TotalPaymentVisible := TRUE;
      END ELSE
        TotalPaymentVisible := FALSE;
    END;

    PROCEDURE UpdateInfoBox@1150000();
    VAR
      ExchRate@1150000 : Record 330;
      Currency@1150001 : Record 4;
    BEGIN
      AgeDays := 0;
      PaymDiscDays := 0;
      DueDays := 0;
      OeRemainAmountFC := 0;
      PaymDiscDeductAmount := 0;
      RemainAfterPayment := 0;
      PMTDiscount := 0;
      AcceptedPaymentTol := 0;

      CustLedgEntry.INIT;
      Cust.INIT;

      IF "Applies-to Doc. No." = '' THEN
        EXIT;
      CustLedgEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Document No.");
      CustLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Document Type","Applies-to Doc. Type");
      CustLedgEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.","Applies-to Doc. No.");
      IF NOT CustLedgEntry.FIND('-') THEN
        EXIT;

      IF Currency.READPERMISSION THEN
        IF Currency.GET("Currency Code") THEN
          Currency.InitRoundingPrecision;
      // Std. Zahlungsbedinungen holen
      IF NOT Cust.GET(CustLedgEntry."Customer No.") THEN;

      // Calculate Days for Age, Payment Discount
      IF "Posting Date" > 0D THEN BEGIN
        IF CustLedgEntry."Posting Date" > 0D THEN
          AgeDays := "Posting Date" - CustLedgEntry."Posting Date";
        IF CustLedgEntry."Pmt. Discount Date" > 0D THEN
          PaymDiscDays := CustLedgEntry."Pmt. Discount Date" - "Posting Date";
        IF CustLedgEntry."Due Date" > 0D THEN
          DueDays := CustLedgEntry."Due Date" - "Posting Date";
      END;

      CustLedgEntry.CALCFIELDS("Remaining Amount","Remaining Amt. (LCY)");
      OeRemainAmountFC := CustLedgEntry."Remaining Amount";
      PMTDiscount :=
        ExchRate.ExchangeAmtFCYToFCY("Posting Date",CustLedgEntry."Currency Code",
          "Currency Code",CustLedgEntry."Remaining Pmt. Disc. Possible");
      PMTDiscount := ROUND(PMTDiscount,Currency."Amount Rounding Precision");

      // calculate FC-amount of open entries and remaining amount
      IF CustLedgEntry."Currency Code" <> "Currency Code" THEN BEGIN
        OeRemainAmountFC :=
          ExchRate.ExchangeAmtLCYToFCY("Posting Date","Currency Code",CustLedgEntry."Remaining Amt. (LCY)","Currency Factor");
        OeRemainAmountFC := ROUND(OeRemainAmountFC,Currency."Amount Rounding Precision");
      END;

      IF (CustLedgEntry."Pmt. Discount Date" >= "Posting Date") OR
         ((CustLedgEntry."Pmt. Disc. Tolerance Date" >= "Posting Date") AND
          CustLedgEntry."Accepted Pmt. Disc. Tolerance")
      THEN BEGIN
        PaymDiscDeductAmount := CustLedgEntry."Remaining Pmt. Disc. Possible";
        IF CustLedgEntry."Currency Code" <> "Currency Code" THEN
          PaymDiscDeductAmount :=
            ExchRate.ExchangeAmtFCYToFCY(
              "Posting Date",CustLedgEntry."Currency Code","Currency Code",PaymDiscDeductAmount);
      END;
      PaymDiscDeductAmount := ROUND(PaymDiscDeductAmount,Currency."Amount Rounding Precision");

      // Accepted Payment Tolerance
      AcceptedPaymentTol := CustLedgEntry."Accepted Payment Tolerance";
      IF CustLedgEntry."Currency Code" <> "Currency Code" THEN
        AcceptedPaymentTol :=
          ExchRate.ExchangeAmtFCYToFCY(
            "Posting Date",CustLedgEntry."Currency Code","Currency Code",AcceptedPaymentTol);
      AcceptedPaymentTol := ROUND(AcceptedPaymentTol,Currency."Amount Rounding Precision");

      CASE TRUE OF
        "Account Type" = "Account Type"::Customer:
          RemainAfterPayment :=
            OeRemainAmountFC + Amount - PaymDiscDeductAmount - AcceptedPaymentTol;
        "Bal. Account Type" = "Bal. Account Type"::Customer:
          RemainAfterPayment :=
            OeRemainAmountFC - Amount - PaymDiscDeductAmount - AcceptedPaymentTol;
      END;

      RemainAfterPaymentVisible := TRUE;
      IF ("Currency Code" <> CustLedgEntry."Currency Code") AND
         (("Currency Code" <> '') AND (CustLedgEntry."Currency Code" <> ''))
      THEN BEGIN
        RemainAfterPaymentVisible := FALSE;
        EXIT;
      END;

      // Pmt. Disc is not applied if entry is not closed
      IF RemainAfterPayment > 0 THEN BEGIN
        RemainAfterPayment := RemainAfterPayment + PaymDiscDeductAmount;
        PaymDiscDeductAmount := 0;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetControlAppearanceFromBatch@76();
    VAR
      GenJournalBatch@1000 : Record 232;
      ApprovalsMgmt@1002 : Codeunit 1535;
      WorkflowWebhookManagement@1001 : Codeunit 1543;
      CanRequestFlowApprovalForAllLines@1003 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      IF ("Journal Template Name" <> '') AND ("Journal Batch Name" <> '') THEN
        GenJournalBatch.GET("Journal Template Name","Journal Batch Name")
      ELSE
        IF NOT GenJournalBatch.GET(GETRANGEMAX("Journal Template Name"),CurrentJnlBatchName) THEN
          EXIT;

      CheckOpenApprovalEntries(GenJournalBatch.RECORDID);

      CanCancelApprovalForJnlBatch := ApprovalsMgmt.CanCancelApprovalForRecord(GenJournalBatch.RECORDID);

      WorkflowWebhookManagement.GetCanRequestAndCanCancelJournalBatch(
        GenJournalBatch,CanRequestFlowApprovalForBatch,CanCancelFlowApprovalForBatch,CanRequestFlowApprovalForAllLines);
      CanRequestFlowApprovalForBatchAndAllLines := CanRequestFlowApprovalForBatch AND CanRequestFlowApprovalForAllLines;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckOpenApprovalEntries@5(BatchRecordId@1000 : RecordID);
    VAR
      ApprovalsMgmt@1001 : Codeunit 1535;
    BEGIN
      OpenApprovalEntriesExistForCurrUserBatch := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntriesForCurrentUser(BatchRecordId);

      OpenApprovalEntriesOnJnlBatchExist := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntries(BatchRecordId);

      OpenApprovalEntriesOnBatchOrAnyJnlLineExist :=
        OpenApprovalEntriesOnJnlBatchExist OR
        ApprovalsMgmt.HasAnyOpenJournalLineApprovalEntries("Journal Template Name","Journal Batch Name");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetControlAppearance@2();
    VAR
      ApprovalsMgmt@1002 : Codeunit 1535;
      WorkflowWebhookManagement@1000 : Codeunit 1543;
      CanRequestFlowApprovalForLine@1001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      OpenApprovalEntriesExistForCurrUser :=
        OpenApprovalEntriesExistForCurrUserBatch OR ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntriesForCurrentUser(RECORDID);

      OpenApprovalEntriesOnJnlLineExist := ApprovalsMgmt.HasOpenApprovalEntries(RECORDID);
      OpenApprovalEntriesOnBatchOrCurrJnlLineExist := OpenApprovalEntriesOnJnlBatchExist OR OpenApprovalEntriesOnJnlLineExist;

      CanCancelApprovalForJnlLine := ApprovalsMgmt.CanCancelApprovalForRecord(RECORDID);

      WorkflowWebhookManagement.GetCanRequestAndCanCancel(RECORDID,CanRequestFlowApprovalForLine,CanCancelFlowApprovalForLine);
      CanRequestFlowApprovalForBatchAndCurrentLine := CanRequestFlowApprovalForBatch AND CanRequestFlowApprovalForLine;
    END;

    END;

    PROCEDURE "Get Customer by Orderno."@1119439002();
    VAR
      SalesInvHead@1119439005 : Record 112;
      SalesHead@1119439004 : Record 36;
      InputDialog@1000 : Page 5295913;
      OrderNo@1119439002 : Code[20];
      CustNo@1119439001 : Code[20];
      PostingText@1119439000 : Text[120];
    BEGIN
      // 01 06.05.11 HBIE ELE000282 Debitor ermitteln mit Auftragsnummer (Button Funktion)

      InputDialog.SetPageType(Text_03, 'CODE');
      IF InputDialog.RUNMODAL() = ACTION::OK THEN
        EVALUATE(OrderNo,InputDialog.GetReturnValue());

      CustNo := '';

      IF DELCHR(OrderNo) = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      IF SalesHead.GET(SalesHead."Document Type"::Order,OrderNo) THEN
        CustNo := SalesHead."Sell-to Customer No."
      ELSE BEGIN

        SalesInvHead.RESET;
        SalesInvHead.SETCURRENTKEY("Order No.");
        SalesInvHead.SETRANGE("Order No.",OrderNo);
        IF SalesInvHead.ISEMPTY THEN
          SalesInvHead.SETFILTER("Order No.",STRSUBSTNO('%1*',OrderNo));
        IF ACTION::LookupOK = PAGE.RUNMODAL(0,SalesInvHead) THEN
          CustNo := SalesInvHead."Sell-to Customer No.";
      END;

      IF CustNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
        IF "Bank Document Entry no." > 0 THEN
          PostingText := Description;
        VALIDATE("Account Type","Account Type"::Customer);
        VALIDATE("Account No.",CustNo);
        IF "Bank Document Entry no." > 0 THEN
          Description := PostingText;
        CurrPage.UPDATE;
      END;
      // 01 06.05.11 HBIE ELE000282 Debitor ermitteln mit Auftragsnummer (Button Funktion) Ende
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckAmount@301510000() AmountReturn : Decimal;
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
      PrepayFound@301510001 : Decimal;
      CustLedgerEntry@301510002 : Record 21;
      RemainingAmount@301510003 : Decimal;
      MACPayGateHandling@301510004 : Codeunit 5227646;
      PaygateEntry@301510005 : Record 50009;
      PaygateAmount@301510006 : Decimal;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,"Order No. Reference") THEN
        IF NOT SalesHeader.GET(SalesHeader."Document Type"::Order,"Document No.") THEN
          EXIT(AmountReturn);
      PrepayFound:=SalesHeader."Pre-Pay Amount (found)"; //bereits geleistete Vorauskasse
      //offene Zahlungen
      CustLedgerEntry.RESET;
      CustLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Customer No.",Open,Positive);
      CustLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Customer No.",SalesHeader."Sell-to Customer No.");
      CustLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      CustLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,FALSE);
      IF CustLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN
        REPEAT
          CustLedgerEntry.CALCFIELDS(CustLedgerEntry."Remaining Amount");
          RemainingAmount+=ABS(CustLedgerEntry."Remaining Amount");
        UNTIL CustLedgerEntry.NEXT=0;
      //offene Zahlungen
      //Paygate Zahlung
      IF MACPayGateHandling.IsPaymentMethodInPayGate(SalesHeader."Payment Method Code") THEN BEGIN
        PaygateEntry.SETRANGE("Document No.",SalesHeader."No.");
        PaygateEntry.SETRANGE("Amount ok",TRUE);
        IF PaygateEntry.FIND('-') THEN
          REPEAT
            PaygateAmount+=PaygateEntry."Request Amount";
          UNTIL PaygateEntry.NEXT=0;
      END;
      //Paygate Zahlung
      SalesHeader.CALCFIELDS("Amount Including VAT");
      AmountReturn:=(SalesHeader."Amount Including VAT"-PrepayFound-RemainingAmount)*-1;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      //00 01 18.11.21 CHRON-4 NKON P252 kopiert Vorkasse vereinnahmen
    }
    END.
  }
}

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPrepayment@301510001();
    VAR
      QuickSalesLine@301510000 : Record 5104607;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510001 : Record 50030;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510002 : Record 50029;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",Rec."Document Type");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",Rec."No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(IsConsignment,TRUE);
      IF QuickSalesLine.COUNT > 1 THEN
        ERROR(Text007);

      IF QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code");
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor ID");
      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.Prepayment THEN BEGIN
        ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.CALCFIELDS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name");
        ERROR(Text006,ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name");
      END;

      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Order No.",Rec."External Document No.");
      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.ISEMPTY THEN
        //InsertApprovalEntry(Rec."External Document No.",QuickSalesLine."Variant Code")
        ERROR(Text010)
      ELSE BEGIN
        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.FINDFIRST;

        {
        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status=ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected THEN
          ERROR(Text013,ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name");
        }

        IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received" THEN
          ERROR(Text008);

      //  IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status=ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected THEN
          IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Processed THEN
            ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Processed  :=  TRUE;

        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received":=TRUE;
        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Inv. Confirmed By":=USERID;
        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Inv. Confirmed Date":=TODAY;
        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Inv. Confirmed Time":=TIME;
        ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.MODIFY
      END;

      Rec."marge checked"  :=  TRUE;
      Rec."Order Status"   :=  Rec."Order Status"::Accept;
      Rec."Change from" := USERID;
      Rec."Change Date":= TODAY;
      Rec.MODIFY;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE InsertApprovalEntry@301510005(OrderNo@301510002 : Code[20];VariantCode@301510001 : Code[10]);
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.INIT;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Order No." := OrderNo;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Variant Code":= VariantCode;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status:=ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Approved;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Processed:=TRUE;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Processed From":=USERID;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Processed Date":=TODAY;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Processed Time":=TIME;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received":=TRUE;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Inv. Confirmed By":=USERID;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Inv. Confirmed Date":=TODAY;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Inv. Confirmed Time":=TIME;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.INSERT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPrepaymentConfirmed@301510002();
    VAR
      QuickSalesLine@301510000 : Record 5104607;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510001 : Record 50030;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup@301510002 : Record 50029;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510003 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document Type",Rec."Document Type");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",Rec."No.");
      QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE(IsConsignment,TRUE);
      IF QuickSalesLine.COUNT > 1 THEN
        ERROR(Text007);

      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Order No.",Rec."External Document No.");
      IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR(Text010);

      IF NOT ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry."Prepayment Invoice Received" THEN
          ERROR(Text009);

      IF QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN;

      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(QuickSalesLine."Variant Code");
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.GET(ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems."Vendor ID");
      IF NOT ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.Prepayment THEN BEGIN
        ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup.CALCFIELDS(ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name");
        ERROR(Text006,ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name");
      END;

      {
      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status=ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status::Rejected THEN
        ERROR(Text013,ConsignmentMarketPlaceSeup."Buy-from Vendor Name");
      }
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckDocumentCheck@301510010();
    BEGIN
      IF NOT ((Rec."marge checked") AND (Rec."Order Status"   =  Rec."Order Status"::Accept))THEN
        ERROR(Text011);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE TestExstockSale@301510006();
    VAR
      ConsignmentManagement@301510000 : Codeunit 50009;
    BEGIN
      //ERP-733
      IF NOT ConsignmentManagement.TestExStockSaleLinesExit(Rec,FALSE) THEN
        ERROR(Text014);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetOrderResponse@301510003();
    VAR
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry@301510000 : Record 50026;
    BEGIN
      VendorResponse := 0;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.RESET;
      ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.SETRANGE("Order No.",Rec."External Document No.");
      IF ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        VendorResponse := ConMrktPlaceEmailEntry.Status;
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 01 14.11.22 SGA ERP-657 Consignment Sales(LVI1.0)
      // 01 17.01.23 SGA ERP-733 Email Notifications from Diva
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetRecFilters@2();
    BEGIN
      IF GETFILTERS <> '' THEN
        UpdateBasicRecFilters;

      EVALUATE(StartingDateFilter,GETFILTER("Starting Date"));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE UpdateBasicRecFilters@17();
    BEGIN
      IF GETFILTER("Sales Type") <> '' THEN
        SalesTypeFilter := GetSalesTypeFilter
      ELSE
        SalesTypeFilter := SalesTypeFilter::None;

      SalesCodeFilter := GETFILTER("Sales Code");
      ItemNoFilter := GETFILTER("Item No.");
      CurrencyCodeFilter := GETFILTER("Currency Code");
    END;

    [Internal]
    PROCEDURE SetRecFilters@1();
    BEGIN
      SalesCodeFilterCtrlEnable := TRUE;

      IF SalesTypeFilter <> SalesTypeFilter::None THEN
        SETRANGE("Sales Type",SalesTypeFilter)
      ELSE
        SETRANGE("Sales Type");

      IF SalesTypeFilter IN [SalesTypeFilter::"All Customers",SalesTypeFilter::None] THEN BEGIN
        SalesCodeFilterCtrlEnable := FALSE;
        SalesCodeFilter := '';
      END;

      IF SalesCodeFilter <> '' THEN
        SETFILTER("Sales Code",SalesCodeFilter)
      ELSE
        SETRANGE("Sales Code");

      IF StartingDateFilter <> '' THEN
        SETFILTER("Starting Date",StartingDateFilter)
      ELSE
        SETRANGE("Starting Date");

      IF ItemNoFilter <> '' THEN BEGIN
        SETFILTER("Item No.",ItemNoFilter);
      END ELSE
        SETRANGE("Item No.");

      IF CurrencyCodeFilter <> '' THEN BEGIN
        SETFILTER("Currency Code",CurrencyCodeFilter);
      END ELSE
        SETRANGE("Currency Code");

      CASE SalesTypeFilter OF
        SalesTypeFilter::Customer:
          CheckFilters(DATABASE::Customer,SalesCodeFilter);
        SalesTypeFilter::"Customer Price Group":
          CheckFilters(DATABASE::"Customer Price Group",SalesCodeFilter);
        SalesTypeFilter::Campaign:
          CheckFilters(DATABASE::Campaign,SalesCodeFilter);
      END;
      CheckFilters(DATABASE::Item,ItemNoFilter);
      CheckFilters(DATABASE::Currency,CurrencyCodeFilter);

      SetEditableFields;
      CurrPage.UPDATE(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetCaption@3() : Text;
    BEGIN
      IF IsOnMobile THEN
        EXIT('');

      EXIT(GetFilterDescription);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetFilterDescription@7() : Text;
    VAR
      ObjTranslation@1000 : Record 377;
      SourceTableName@1002 : Text;
      SalesSrcTableName@1003 : Text;
      Description@1001 : Text;
    BEGIN
      GetRecFilters;

      SourceTableName := '';
      IF ItemNoFilter <> '' THEN
        SourceTableName := ObjTranslation.TranslateObject(ObjTranslation."Object Type"::Table,27);

      SalesSrcTableName := '';
      CASE SalesTypeFilter OF
        SalesTypeFilter::Customer:
          BEGIN
            SalesSrcTableName := ObjTranslation.TranslateObject(ObjTranslation."Object Type"::Table,18);
            Cust."No." := COPYSTR(SalesCodeFilter,1,MAXSTRLEN(Cust."No."));
            IF Cust.FIND THEN
              Description := Cust.Name;
          END;
        SalesTypeFilter::"Customer Price Group":
          BEGIN
            SalesSrcTableName := ObjTranslation.TranslateObject(ObjTranslation."Object Type"::Table,6);
            CustPriceGr.Code := COPYSTR(SalesCodeFilter,1,MAXSTRLEN(CustPriceGr.Code));
            IF CustPriceGr.FIND THEN
              Description := CustPriceGr.Description;
          END;
        SalesTypeFilter::Campaign:
          BEGIN
            SalesSrcTableName := ObjTranslation.TranslateObject(ObjTranslation."Object Type"::Table,5071);
            Campaign."No." := COPYSTR(SalesCodeFilter,1,MAXSTRLEN(Campaign."No."));
            IF Campaign.FIND THEN
              Description := Campaign.Description;
          END;
        SalesTypeFilter::"All Customers":
          BEGIN
            SalesSrcTableName := Text000;
            Description := '';
          END;
      END;

      IF SalesSrcTableName = Text000 THEN
        EXIT(STRSUBSTNO('%1 %2 %3',SalesSrcTableName,SourceTableName,ItemNoFilter));
      EXIT(STRSUBSTNO('%1 %2 %3 %4 %5',SalesSrcTableName,SalesCodeFilter,Description,SourceTableName,ItemNoFilter));
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckFilters@4(TableNo@1000 : Integer;FilterTxt@1001 : Text);
    VAR
      FilterRecordRef@1002 : RecordRef;
      FilterFieldRef@1003 : FieldRef;
    BEGIN
      IF FilterTxt = '' THEN
        EXIT;
      CLEAR(FilterRecordRef);
      CLEAR(FilterFieldRef);
      FilterRecordRef.OPEN(TableNo);
      FilterFieldRef := FilterRecordRef.FIELD(1);
      FilterFieldRef.SETFILTER(FilterTxt);
      IF FilterRecordRef.ISEMPTY THEN
        ERROR(Text001,FilterRecordRef.CAPTION,FilterTxt);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetSalesTypeFilter@1000() : Integer;
    BEGIN
      CASE GETFILTER("Sales Type") OF
        FORMAT("Sales Type"::Customer):
          EXIT(0);
        FORMAT("Sales Type"::"Customer Price Group"):
          EXIT(1);
        FORMAT("Sales Type"::"All Customers"):
          EXIT(2);
        FORMAT("Sales Type"::Campaign):
          EXIT(3);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetSalesCodeEditable@5(SalesType@1000 : Option) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      EXIT(SalesType <> "Sales Type"::"All Customers");
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetEditableFields@10();
    BEGIN
      SalesTypeControlEditable := GETFILTER("Sales Type") = '';
      SalesCodeControlEditable :=
        SalesCodeControlEditable AND (GETFILTER("Sales Code") = '');
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FilterLines@6();
    VAR
      FilterPageBuilder@1000 : FilterPageBuilder;
    BEGIN
      FilterPageBuilder.ADDTABLE(TABLECAPTION,DATABASE::"Sales Price");

      FilterPageBuilder.SETVIEW(TABLECAPTION,GETVIEW);
      IF GETFILTER("Sales Type") = '' THEN
        FilterPageBuilder.ADDFIELDNO(TABLECAPTION,FIELDNO("Sales Type"));
      IF GETFILTER("Sales Code") = '' THEN
        FilterPageBuilder.ADDFIELDNO(TABLECAPTION,FIELDNO("Sales Code"));
      IF GETFILTER("Item No.") = '' THEN
        FilterPageBuilder.ADDFIELDNO(TABLECAPTION,FIELDNO("Item No."));
      IF GETFILTER("Starting Date") = '' THEN
        FilterPageBuilder.ADDFIELDNO(TABLECAPTION,FIELDNO("Starting Date"));
      IF GETFILTER("Currency Code") = '' THEN
        FilterPageBuilder.ADDFIELDNO(TABLECAPTION,FIELDNO("Currency Code"));

      IF FilterPageBuilder.RUNMODAL THEN
        SETVIEW(FilterPageBuilder.GETVIEW(TABLECAPTION));

      UpdateBasicRecFilters;
      EVALUATE(StartingDateFilter,GETFILTER("Starting Date"));
      SetEditableFields;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CopyPrices@8();
    VAR
      Customer@1001 : Record 18;
      SalesPrice@1004 : Record 7002;
      SelectedSalesPrice@1005 : Record 7002;
      SalesPrices@1002 : Page 7002;
      CopyToCustomerNo@1003 : Code[20];
    BEGIN
      IF SalesTypeFilter <> SalesTypeFilter::Customer THEN
        ERROR(IncorrectSalesTypeToCopyPricesErr);
      Customer.SETFILTER("No.",SalesCodeFilter);
      IF Customer.COUNT <> 1 THEN
        ERROR(MultipleCustomersSelectedErr);
      CopyToCustomerNo := COPYSTR(SalesCodeFilter,1,MAXSTRLEN(CopyToCustomerNo));
      SalesPrice.SETRANGE("Sales Type",SalesPrice."Sales Type"::Customer);
      SalesPrice.SETFILTER("Sales Code",'<>%1',SalesCodeFilter);
      SalesPrices.LOOKUPMODE(TRUE);
      SalesPrices.SETTABLEVIEW(SalesPrice);
      IF SalesPrices.RUNMODAL = ACTION::LookupOK THEN BEGIN
        SalesPrices.GetSelectionFilter(SelectedSalesPrice);
        CopySalesPriceToCustomersSalesPrice(SelectedSalesPrice,CopyToCustomerNo);
      END;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetSelectionFilter@9(VAR SalesPrice@1000 : Record 7002);
    BEGIN
      CurrPage.SETSELECTIONFILTER(SalesPrice);
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 14.11.22 SGA ERP-657 Consignment Sales(LVI1.0)
    }
    END.
  }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckPurchase@301510000();
    VAR
      PurchaseHeader@301510000 : Record 38;
    BEGIN
      PurchOrderNo := '';
      PurchaseHeader.RESET;
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.",Rec."Order No.");
      IF PurchaseHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        PurchOrderNo := PurchaseHeader."No.";
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CreatePurchaseOrder@301510001();
    VAR
      QuickSalesHeader@301510000 : Record 5104606;
      ConsignmentManagement@301510001 : Codeunit 50009;
    BEGIN
      QuickSalesHeader.RESET;
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.","Order No.");
      IF QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN
        ConsignmentManagement.CreatePurchaseOrder(QuickSalesHeader);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FindPrices@301510002();
    VAR
      QuickSalesHeader@301510003 : Record 5104606;
      QuickSalesLine@301510000 : Record 5104607;
      PurchaseHeader@301510002 : Record 38;
      PurchaseLine@301510001 : Record 39;
      PurchInvHeader@301510004 : Record 122;
      PurchInvLine@301510005 : Record 123;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems@301510006 : Record 50030;
    BEGIN
      SalesPrice := 0;
      PurchasePrice := 0;
      InventoryOrders := FALSE;
      QuickSalesHeader.RESET;
      QuickSalesHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.","Order No.");
      IF QuickSalesHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        IF QuickSalesHeader.Workflow = QuickSalesHeader.Workflow::Postprocessing THEN
          OrderStatus := 'Post Processing';
        QuickSalesLine.RESET;
        QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",QuickSalesHeader."No.");
        QuickSalesLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code","Variant Code");
        IF QuickSalesLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          SalesPrice := QuickSalesLine."Unit Price";
          ItemNo := QuickSalesLine."No.";
          IF QuickSalesLine.VendorId = '' THEN
            InventoryOrders  := TRUE;
        END;
      END;

      PurchaseHeader.RESET;
      PurchaseHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.","Order No.");
      IF PurchaseHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        PurchaseLine.RESET;
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchaseHeader."No.");
        PurchaseLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code","Variant Code");
        IF PurchaseLine.FINDFIRST THEN
          PurchasePrice := PurchaseLine."Direct Unit Cost";
      END ELSE BEGIN
        PurchInvHeader.RESET;
        PurchInvHeader.SETRANGE("Vendor Order No.","Order No.");
        IF PurchInvHeader.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          PurchInvLine.RESET;
          PurchInvLine.SETRANGE("Document No.",PurchInvHeader."No.");
          PurchInvLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code","Variant Code");
          IF PurchInvLine.FINDFIRST THEN
            PurchasePrice := PurchInvLine."Direct Unit Cost";
        END;
      END;

      ListPrice := 0;
      ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.GET(Rec."Variant Code");
      ListPrice := ConsignmentMarketPlaceItems.Price;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckSalesOrder@301510003();
    VAR
      SalesHeader@301510000 : Record 36;
      SalesInvoiceHeader@301510001 : Record 112;
      SalesHeaderArchive@301510002 : Record 5107;
    BEGIN
      OrderStatus := '';
      SalesOrderExists := FALSE;
      IF SalesHeader.GET(1,Rec."Order No.") THEN BEGIN
        OrderStatus := 'Order Created';
        SalesOrderExists := TRUE
      END ELSE BEGIN
        SalesInvoiceHeader.RESET;
        SalesInvoiceHeader.SETRANGE("External Document No.",Rec."Order No.");
        IF NOT SalesInvoiceHeader.ISEMPTY THEN
          OrderStatus := 'Posted Invoice'
        ELSE BEGIN
          SalesHeaderArchive.RESET;
          SalesHeaderArchive.SETRANGE("No.",Rec."Order No.");
          IF NOT SalesHeaderArchive.ISEMPTY THEN
            OrderStatus := 'Order Cancelled';
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CheckItemType@301510004();
    VAR
      ItemAttributeValueMapping@301510000 : Record 7505;
      ItemVariant@301510001 : Record 5401;
    BEGIN
      ItemType := '';
      //Table ID,No.,Item Attribute ID,Item Variant Code,Serial No.
      IF ItemAttributeValueMapping.GET(5401,ItemNo,101,Rec."Variant Code",'') THEN BEGIN
        IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" = 225998 THEN
          ItemType := 'Watch'
        ELSE IF ItemAttributeValueMapping."Item Attribute Value ID" = 225999 THEN
          ItemType := 'Jewellery'
      END;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 00 14.11.22 SGA ERP-657 Consignment Sales(LVI1.0)
    }
    END.
  }

    PROCEDURE LBlobMgmt@1000000000(PBlobType@1000000020 : 'Request,Response');
    BEGIN
      CASE PBlobType OF
        PBlobType::Request :
          IF Request.HASVALUE THEN BEGIN
            CALCFIELDS(Request);
            GTempBlob.Blob := Request;
            GFileMgmt.BLOBExport(GTempBlob,STRSUBSTNO('WebServiceLog_Request_%1.log',"Entry No."),TRUE);
          END;
        PBlobType::Response :
          IF Response.HASVALUE THEN BEGIN
            CALCFIELDS(Response);
            GTempBlob.Blob := Response;
            GFileMgmt.BLOBExport(GTempBlob,STRSUBSTNO('WebServiceLog_Response_%1.log',"Entry No."),TRUE);
          END;
      END;
    END;

      // 00 01.08.22 SGA ERP-649 Log firstName & lastName issues

OBJECT Page 50099 ItemLedger Entries Date
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=22.02.23;
    Time=08:42:27;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    DeleteAllowed=No;
    SourceTable=Table32;
    PageType=List;
    SourceTableTemporary=Yes;
    ActionList=ACTIONS
    {
      { 301510021;   ;ActionContainer;
                      ActionContainerType=ActionItems }
      { 301510023;1  ;ActionGroup }
      { 301510022;2  ;Action    ;
                      Name=toPosting;
                      CaptionML=[DEU=Datum bis;
                                 ENU=Date to];
                      Promoted=Yes;
                      PromotedIsBig=Yes;
                      Image=DateRange;
                      OnAction=VAR
                                 CustomerSetup@301510000 : Record 87000;
                                 ItemLedgerEntry@301510001 : Record 32;
                                 ItemApplicationEntry@301510003 : Record 339;
                                 Inventory_@301510004 : Decimal;
                                 InputPage@301510002 : Page 5295913;
                                 Text01L@301510005 : TextConst 'DEU=bis Datum;ENU=to Date';
                                 CalcTrue@301510006 : Boolean;
                                 ILECheck@301510007 : Record 32;
                               BEGIN
                                 Rec.DELETEALL;
                                 CLEAR(InputPage);
                                 InputPage.SetPageType(Text01L,'DATE');
                                 //InputPage.SetFieldContent(LocationCode);
                                 //InputPage.LookUPPageID(15);
                                 InputPage.RUNMODAL;
                                 toPosting := FORMAT(InputPage.GetReturnValue);
                                 EVALUATE(ToPostingDate,toPosting);
                                 CustomerSetup.GET;
                                 CustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Box Item");
                                 CustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Manufacturer SerialNo. Attribu");



                                 ItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
                                 ItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY(Positive,"Serial No.","Posting Date");
                                 ItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
                                 ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Serial No.",'<>%1','');
                                 ItemLedgerEntry.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',0D,ToPostingDate);

                                 IF ItemLedgerEntry.FIND('-') THEN BEGIN
                                   REPEAT
                                     //Buchungsdatum Verschiebung
                                     CLEAR(CalcTrue);
                                     ILECheck.RESET;
                                     ILECheck.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.","Posting Date");
                                     ILECheck.SETFILTER("Serial No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Serial No.");
                                     ILECheck.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',0D,ToPostingDate);
                                     ILECheck.CALCSUMS("Remaining Quantity");
                                     CalcTrue:=ILECheck."Remaining Quantity">0;
                                     IF CalcTrue THEN BEGIN

                                       CLEAR(Inventory_);
                                       ItemApplicationEntry.SETRANGE("Inbound Item Entry No.",ItemLedgerEntry."Entry No.");
                                       ItemApplicationEntry.SETFILTER("Posting Date",'%1..%2',0D,ToPostingDate);
                                       ItemApplicationEntry.CALCSUMS(Quantity);
                                       Inventory_:=ItemApplicationEntry.Quantity;
                                       IF Inventory_ > 0 THEN BEGIN
                                         Rec.INIT;
                                         Rec.TRANSFERFIELDS(ItemLedgerEntry);
                                         Rec."Remaining Quantity":=Inventory_;
                                         Rec.INSERT;
                                       END;
                                     END;
                                   UNTIL ItemLedgerEntry.NEXT=0;
                                 END;

                               END;
                                }
    }

    BEGIN
      EXIT(("Read Permission" <> "Read Permission"::" ") OR

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE LoadBaseObjects@1103308002();
    VAR
      LicPerm@1103308003 : Record 2000000043;
      Object@1103308002 : Record 2000000001;
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(Rec);
      DELETEALL;

      Object.SETFILTER(Type,'Table|Report|Page|Codeunit|XMLport|Query');
      Object.SETFILTER(ID,'<>%1',0);
      Object.FINDSET;
      REPEAT
        "Role ID" := 'DUMMY';
        "Object Type" := Object.Type;
        "Object ID" := Object.ID;
        IF LicPerm.GET(Object.Type,Object.ID) THEN BEGIN
          "Read Permission" := LicPerm."Read Permission";
          "Execute Permission" := LicPerm."Execute Permission";
          "Insert Permission" := LicPerm."Insert Permission";
          "Modify Permission" := LicPerm."Modify Permission";
          "Delete Permission" := LicPerm."Delete Permission";
        END;
        INSERT;
      UNTIL Object.NEXT = 0;
    END;

        SETRANGE("Bool 1",TRUE);
        IF "Bool 1" THEN BEGIN

          SETRANGE("Integer 1","Integer 1");

        END ELSE BEGIN
          IF COUNT = 1 THEN BEGIN
            MODIFYALL("Bool 1","Bool 1");
          END;
        END;
      END;

  PROPERTIES
  {
    SourceTable=Table36;
    PageType=StandardDialog;
    SourceTableTemporary=Yes;
    OnOpenPage=BEGIN
                 gCustomerManagement.GetDepositDefinition(Rec,gYesNo);
               END;

    OnQueryClosePage=VAR
                       OrderNotFound@301480001 : TextConst 'DEU=Auftrag %1 existiert nicht.;ENU=Order %1 does not exist.';
                     BEGIN
                       IF CloseAction = ACTION::Cancel THEN
                         EXIT(TRUE);

                       IF (gCurrentOrderAmount < gDepositAmount) AND (gYesNo = gYesNo::Yes) THEN
                         ERROR(DepositAmountGreater);

                       IF (gDepositAmount < 0) AND (gYesNo = gYesNo::Yes)THEN
                         ERROR(DepositAmountNegative);

                       // 01 06.12.18 CHR-000 Anzahlungsbetrag 0 nicht zulassen
                       IF (gYesNo = gYesNo::Yes) AND (gDepositAmount = 0) THEN
                         ERROR(DepositAmountZero);
                       // 01 06.12.18 CHR-000 Anzahlungsbetrag 0 nicht zulassen ENDE

                       IF NOT gCustomerManagement.SetDepositDefinition(Rec.RECORDID,gYesNo,gDepositAmount) THEN
                         MESSAGE(OrderNotFound,Rec."No.");
                       EXIT(TRUE);
                     END;

  }

                ContainerType=ContentArea }

                                 ENU=" ,Yes,No"];

      IF errorMsg <> '' THEN
        ERROR(errorMsg);

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

                                    REPEAT

                                 OldRec.SETRANGE(Variantenkategorie,'SW 2023');
                                 OldRec.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemAttributeCollectionRec."Item No.");
                                 IF OldRec.FINDLAST THEN
                                   NewCode:= OldRec.Code;

                                 IPM.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemAttributeCollectionRec."Item No.");
                                 IPM.SETRANGE("Variant Code",NewCode);
                                 IF IPM.FINDSET THEN
                                   REPEAT
                                     IPM2.INIT;
                                     IPM2.TRANSFERFIELDS(IPM);
                                     IPM2."Variant Code":= ItemAttributeCollectionRec.Code;
                                     IF IPM2.INSERT THEN;
                                   UNTIL IPM.NEXT=0
                                  UNTIL ItemAttributeCollectionRec.NEXT=0;
                                 MESSAGE('done');
                               END;
                                }

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FilterByFunctions@301480005();
    VAR
      CloseAction@301480003 : Action;
      FilterText@301480002 : Text;
      FilterPageID@301480001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      FilterPageID := PAGE::"Filter Items by Function";
      FillTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer;

      CloseAction := PAGE.RUNMODAL(FilterPageID,gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer);
      IF (CURRENTCLIENTTYPE <> CLIENTTYPE::Phone) AND (CloseAction <> ACTION::LookupOK) THEN
        EXIT;

      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,TRUE);
      IF gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
        ClearFunctionsFilter;
        EXIT;
      END;
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;

      FindItemVariantsByItemFunctions(gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer);

      Rec.MARKEDONLY(TRUE);
    END;

    [External]
    PROCEDURE FindItemVariantsByItemFunctions@301480000(VAR FilterItemFunctionsBuffer@1001 : Record 85008);
    BEGIN
      ActiveFunctionsFilter := STRSUBSTNO('Filter: %1',GetFunctionNameFilter);

      RunSQLQuery;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer@301480007();
    VAR
      SystemValueLine@301480000 : Record 5105031;
    BEGIN
      IF NOT gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.ISEMPTY THEN
        EXIT;

      SystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",85000);
      IF SystemValueLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.INIT;
          gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute := SystemValueLine.Description;
          gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.INSERT;
        UNTIL SystemValueLine.NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ClearFunctionsFilter@301480012();
    BEGIN
      CLEARMARKS;
      MARKEDONLY(FALSE);

      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.DELETEALL;
      ActiveFunctionsFilter := '';

      //  ApplyFilter;

    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE RunDuplicateItemVariant@301490000();
    VAR
      ItemVariant@301490001 : Record 5401;
      Rec2@301490004 : Record 85011;
      CustomerManagement@301490000 : Codeunit 87000;
      CHNXAttributeMgt@301490003 : Codeunit 85020;
      NewItemVariantCode@301490002 : Code[10];
      ItemAttributeCollectionRec@301510000 : Record 85011;
    BEGIN
       ItemVariant.GET(Rec."Item No.",Rec.Code); //old item variant
       NewItemVariantCode := CustomerManagement.DuplicateItemVariantWithAttributes(ItemVariant);

       IF ItemVariant.GET(Rec."Item No.",NewItemVariantCode) THEN //new item variant
        IF GETFILTERS <> '' THEN BEGIN
          RESET;
          SETVIEW(Rec2.GETVIEW);
          CurrPage.UPDATE(FALSE);
        END;

       // 01 23.05.19 MKLE CHR-548 Select New Item Variant
       IF NewItemVariantCode <> '' THEN BEGIN
        GET(Rec."Item No.",NewItemVariantCode);
       // 01 23.05.19 MKLE CHR-548 Select New Item Variant ENDE
       // 01 27.05.19 LACK CHR-548 Kleiner Fix
        gNewVariant := NewItemVariantCode;
       END;
       // 01 27.05.19 LACK CHR-548 Kleiner Fix Ende
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetFunctionNameFilter@301490003() : Text;
    VAR
      FunctionNameFilter@301490000 : Text;
    BEGIN
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,TRUE);
      IF gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          FunctionNameFilter += gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute+'|';
      UNTIL gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.NEXT = 0;
      EXIT(DELCHR(FunctionNameFilter, '>', ',')); //delete last pipe
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetFunctionIDFilter@301490004() : Text;
    VAR
      SystemValueLine@301490000 : Record 5105031;
      FunctionIDFilter@301490001 : Text;
      QuoteTxt@301490002 : TextConst 'DEU=''';
    BEGIN
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,TRUE);
      IF gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          SystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",85000);
          SystemValueLine.SETRANGE(Description,gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.Attribute);
          IF SystemValueLine.FINDSET THEN
            REPEAT
              FunctionIDFilter += QuoteTxt+UPPERCASE(SystemValueLine."System Code")+QuoteTxt+',';
            UNTIL SystemValueLine.NEXT = 0;
        UNTIL gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.NEXT = 0;
      EXIT(DELCHR(FunctionIDFilter, '>', ',')); //delete last pipe
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetFunctionCount@301490005() : Integer;
    BEGIN
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.RESET;
      gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.SETRANGE(Value,TRUE);
      EXIT(gTempFilterItemFunctionsBuffer.COUNT);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ExportToExcel@301490007();
    BEGIN
      REPORT.RUN(REPORT::"Item Attribute Collection Exp",FALSE,FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE RunSQLQuery@301490006();
    VAR
      SQLManagement@301490000 : Codeunit 5105081;
      TempSQLResultLine@301490001 : TEMPORARY Record 5295431;
      ItemAttributeCollection2@301490002 : Record 85011;
      Qry@301490003 : Text;
    BEGIN
      //AdditionalFilter := GetFunctionNameFilter;
      Qry := STRSUBSTNO(
      'SELECT FunctionCount.[Item No_],IV.[Code], FunctionCount.CNT FROM '+
      '(SELECT [Item No_],COUNT([Function Id]) AS CNT FROM [dbo].[CHRONEXT-GmbH$Item Function Mapping] WITH(NOLOCK)  '+
      'WHERE [Function Id] IN(%1)  '+
      'GROUP BY [Item No_]) AS FunctionCount  '+
      'JOIN [dbo].[CHRONEXT-GmbH$Item Variant] IV '+
      'ON FunctionCount.[Item No_] = IV.[Item No_] '+
      'WHERE FunctionCount.CNT >= %2',GetFunctionIDFilter,GetFunctionCount);

      SQLManagement.ExecuteRawSQLStatementSaveResult(Qry,TempSQLResultLine);
      IF TempSQLResultLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF Rec.GET(TempSQLResultLine."Text 1",TempSQLResultLine."Text 2") THEN
            Rec.MARK(TRUE);
        UNTIL TempSQLResultLine.NEXT = 0;
    END;

      // 01 13.06.19 LACK CHR-548 CopyItem verbessern
      // 01 26.06.19 MBLA CHR-548 Anforderungen Artikel / Varianten: Auswahl exportieren

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ScanItem@301480003(Scancode@301480000 : Text) : Boolean;
    VAR
      ItemVariant@301480002 : Record 5401;
      Item@301480003 : Record 27;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301480005 : Record 5767;
      LogisticMgt@301480004 : Codeunit 5104803;
      DiVAItemTrackingMgt@301480001 : Codeunit 5104818;
      BinCodeTemplate@301480006 : Code[20];
    BEGIN

      IF (NextAction <> NextAction::ItemNo) THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      CLEAR(ItemNo);
      CLEAR(VariantCode);
      CLEAR(UOM);
      CLEAR(SerialNo);
      IF LogisticMgt.CalcItemVariantFromScancode(Scancode,ItemNo,VariantCode,UOM,SerialNo) THEN BEGIN
        EAN := Scancode;
        Item.GET(ItemNo);
        BinCodeTemplate := '';
        IF SerialNo <> '' THEN BEGIN
          WarehouseActivityLine.RESET;
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Location Code","Activity Type","Bin Type Code","Unit of Measure Code","Variant Code","Breakbulk No.","Action Type","Lot No.","Serial No.");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type"::"Put-away");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",VariantCode);
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place);
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Serial No.",SerialNo);
          IF WarehouseActivityLine.FINDFIRST THEN
            BinCodeTemplate := WarehouseActivityLine."Bin Code";
        END;
        IF BinCodeTemplate <> '' THEN
          ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text011,ItemNo,VariantCode,Item.Description,BinCodeTemplate)
        ELSE
          ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text008,ItemNo,VariantCode,Item.Description);
      END ELSE BEGIN
        ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text002,Text001,Scancode);
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;

      LastAction := NextAction;
      NextAction := NextAction::BinCode;
      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ScanBinCode@301480004(Scancode@301480000 : Text) : Boolean;
    VAR
      Bin@301480001 : Record 7354;
      WarehouseActivityLine@301510000 : Record 5767;
    BEGIN
      IF NextAction = NextAction::BinCode THEN BEGIN
        CustomerSetup.TESTFIELD("Mail Order Location Code");
        IF Bin.GET(CustomerSetup."Mail Order Location Code",Scancode) THEN BEGIN
          //NKON 27.07.20
          WarehouseActivityLine.RESET;
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Location Code","Activity Type","Bin Type Code","Unit of Measure Code","Variant Code","Breakbulk No.","Action Type","Lot No.","Serial No.");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Item No.",ItemNo);
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Activity Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Activity Type"::"Put-away");
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Variant Code",VariantCode);
          WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Action Type",WarehouseActivityLine."Action Type"::Place);
          //WarehouseActivityLine.SETRANGE("Serial No.",SerialNo);
          IF WarehouseActivityLine.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
            WarehouseActivityLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",Scancode);
            WarehouseActivityLine.MODIFY;
            COMMIT;
          END;

          LastAction := NextAction;
          NextAction := NextAction::ItemNo;
          CLEAR(MDEMgt);
          MDEMgt.Initialize(
            'WhsePutAway',
            MDEUserID,
            '',
            '',
            '',
            EAN,
            '',
            '',
            Bin."Location Code",
            Bin.Code,
            1,
            '',
            '',
            '',
            '',
            '{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}');
          ErrorMessage := 'Aufruf MDE Mangement Codeunit';
          CLEARLASTERROR;
          IF MDEMgt.RUN THEN BEGIN
            COMMIT;
            IF SerialNo <> '' THEN
              ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text006,ItemNo,SerialNo,Bin.Code)
            ELSE
              ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text010,ItemNo,CustomerSetup."Prefix Box Reference" + VariantCode,Bin.Code);
          END ELSE
            ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text005,Text001,GETLASTERRORTEXT);
          EXIT(TRUE);
        END ELSE
          ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text007,Text001,Scancode);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ScanHandling@1000000000();
    VAR
      Color@1000000002 : DotNet "'System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a'.System.Drawing.Color";
      TestSuiteManagement@1001050000 : Codeunit 5295500;
      ErrorPage@1000000000 : Page 5104779;
      ActionFound@1000000001 : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      CLEAR(ErrorMessage);
      CLEAR(ActionFound);
      Scancode := UPPERCASE(Scancode);
      CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.ForeColor(Color.Black);
      IF Scancode = '' THEN
        EXIT;

      IF NOT ActionFound THEN
        ActionFound := ScanFunction(Scancode);

      IF NOT ActionFound THEN
        ActionFound := ScanItem(Scancode);

      IF NOT ActionFound THEN
        ActionFound := ScanLocation(Scancode);

      IF NOT ActionFound THEN
        ActionFound := ScanBin(Scancode);

      // Fehler ausgeben wenn keine Aktion ausgefÅhrt wurde
      IF NOT ActionFound THEN BEGIN
        //ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text009,Text001, Scancode);
        DoBeep(TRUE);
      END
      ELSE
        DoBeep(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ScanFunction@301490020(Scancode@301490000 : Text) : Boolean;

        Reset(TRUE);
        EXIT(TRUE);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE ScanItem@301480003(Scancode@301480000 : Text) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lBinContent@301490005 : Record 7302;
      lItem@301490006 : Record 27;
      lItemNo@301490003 : Code[20];
      lVariantCode@301490002 : Code[10];
      lUOM@301490001 : Code[10];
      lLocation@301490000 : Code[10];
      lDiVAItemTrackingMgt@301490004 : Codeunit 5104818;
      lIsBox@301490007 : Boolean;
      pos@301510000 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF (NextAction <> NextAction::ItemNo) THEN
        EXIT(FALSE);

      getCustomerSetup;
      IF COPYSTR(Scancode,1,STRLEN(gCustomerSetup."Prefix Box Reference")) = gCustomerSetup."Prefix Box Reference" THEN
        lIsBox := TRUE;

      IF (lDiVAItemTrackingMgt.CalcItemVariantFromSerialNo(Scancode,lItemNo,lVariantCode,lUOM)) OR lIsBox THEN BEGIN
          IF lIsBox THEN BEGIN
            lItem.GET(gCustomerSetup."Box Item");
            lUOM := lItem."Base Unit of Measure";
            // 01 27.04.20 NKON ERP-23 Suffix BV Mandant ist 2 stellig
            IF COMPANYNAME = 'Chronext Purchasing B.V.' THEN BEGIN
              pos:=STRPOS(Scancode,'V');
              IF pos = 2 THEN
                lVariantCode := COPYSTR(Scancode,3,STRLEN(Scancode))
              ELSE
               lVariantCode := COPYSTR(Scancode,2,STRLEN(Scancode))
            END ELSE
            // 01 27.04.20 NKON ERP-23 Suffix BV Mandant ist 2 stellig
              lVariantCode := COPYSTR(Scancode,STRLEN(gCustomerSetup."Prefix Box Reference") + 1,STRLEN(Scancode));
            lLocation := CalcSourceLocation('',gCustomerSetup."Box Item",lVariantCode,'');
            // 01 27.04.20 NKON ERP-23 Suffix BV Mandant ist 2 stellig
            //Artikel wird gescannt beginnt auch mit B (bzw. Seriennr. )
            IF lLocation = '' THEN BEGIN
              lLocation := CalcSourceLocation(Scancode,'','','');
              IF lLocation <> '' THEN BEGIN
                lIsBox:=FALSE;
                lItem.GET(gItemNo1);
                gItemNo:=gItemNo1;
              END;
            END;
            // 01 27.04.20 NKON ERP-23 Suffix BV Mandant ist 2 stellig
            IF lLocation = '' THEN BEGIN
              ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text013,Scancode);
              EXIT(FALSE);
            END;
            IF lIsBox THEN
              SetScanVariables('',gCustomerSetup."Box Item",lVariantCode,lUOM,lLocation,'','',lIsBox)
            ELSE
              SetScanVariables(Scancode,gItemNo1,gVariant1,lUOM,lLocation,'','',lIsBox)
          END
          ELSE BEGIN
            lLocation := CalcSourceLocation(Scancode,lItemNo,lVariantCode,lUOM);
            IF lLocation = '' THEN BEGIN
              ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text013,Scancode);
              EXIT(FALSE);
            END;
            SetScanVariables(Scancode,lItemNo,lVariantCode,lUOM,lLocation,'','',lIsBox);
          END;
          GetBinContent(lBinContent);
          GBin:= lBinContent."Bin Code";//SKU
          IF gIsBox THEN
            ErrorMessage := Text002 + ' | ' + STRSUBSTNO(Text005a,lLocation)
          ELSE
            ErrorMessage := Text002 + ' | ' + STRSUBSTNO(Text005,lLocation);
          IF lBinContent."Bin Code" <> '' THEN
            ErrorMessage += ' | ' + STRSUBSTNO(Text008,lBinContent."Bin Code");
          LastScancode := gSerial;
          IF (lBinContent."Bin Code" = 'EINGHL') OR (lBinContent."Bin Code" = 'AUSGHL') THEN BEGIN
            CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.ForeColor(Color.Red);
            EXIT(FALSE);
          END;
          LastAction := NextAction;
          NextAction := NextAction::Location;
          EXIT(TRUE);
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text013,Scancode);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
    END;

        lBin.RESET;

        //SKU++

        IF Scancode='TLOC10' THEN BEGIN
        FindOrAddAttribute(102,209982);
        EXIT;
        END;
        IF Scancode='TLOC30' THEN BEGIN
        FindOrAddAttribute(102,209983);
        EXIT;

        IF ((GBin= 'TLOC10') OR (GBin='TLOC30')) AND ((Scancode<>'TLOC10') OR (Scancode<>'TLOC30')) THEN

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Post@301490018() return : Boolean;
    VAR
      lSourceLocation@301490000 : Record 14;
      lTargetLocation@301490001 : Record 14;
    BEGIN
      COMMIT;
      // PrÅfen welche Variante gebucht wird
      lSourceLocation.GET(gSourceLocation);
      lTargetLocation.GET(gTargetLocation);

      ErrorMessage := '';
      //Umbuchung im Hauptlager -> Log Artikel Buchblatt
      IF (lSourceLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") AND (lTargetLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") AND (gSourceLocation = gTargetLocation) THEN
        return := PostRelocation;

      //Strukturiert auf Unstruckturiert | Unstruckturiert auf Strukturiert
      IF (lSourceLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") AND ( NOT lTargetLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") THEN
        return := PostWhseMovementLocation(TRUE);
      IF (NOT lSourceLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") AND (lTargetLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") THEN
        return := PostWhseMovementLocation(FALSE);


      //Artikel Buchblatt Unstruckturiert auf Unstruckturiert
      IF (NOT lSourceLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") AND (NOT lTargetLocation."Directed Put-away and Pick") THEN
        return := PostItemReclss;
      // Wenn alles in Butter -> Reset
      IF return THEN
        Reset(FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PostRelocation@301490012() : Boolean;
    VAR
      lWarehouseJournalLine@301490002 : Record 7311;

      lItemTrackingCode@301490006 : Record 6502;
      lLogisticMgt@301490007 : Codeunit 5104803;
    BEGIN
      //Umlagerung im Hauptlager
      getCustomerSetup;
      lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Location Code",gSourceLocation);
      lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",gCustomerSetup.RelocationJT);
      lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE(Name,gCustomerSetup.RelocationName);
      IF NOT lWarehouseJournalBatch.FINDFIRST THEN
        ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(Text004,gSourceLocation,gCustomerSetup.RelocationJT,gCustomerSetup.RelocationName));

      lWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Location Code";
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name" := lWarehouseJournalBatch.Name;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SetUpNewLine(lWarehouseJournalLine);
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Reason Code" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Reason Code";
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Line No." := 10000;

      //Filter setzen
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",lWarehouseJournalLine."Line No.");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",lWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code");

      lWarehouseJournalLine."Item No." := gItemNo;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Variant Code" := gVariantCode;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Unit of Measure Code" := gUOM;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Whse. Document No." := USERID;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Registering Date" := TODAY;
      lWarehouseJournalLine.Description := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME) + ' ' + FORMAT(USERID);

      // Inhalt finden
      GetBinContent(lBinContent);
      IF NOT lBinContent.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text007,gSerial);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("From Zone Code",lBinContent."Zone Code");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("From Bin Code",lBinContent."Bin Code");

      lBin.GET(gTargetLocation,gBinCode);
      lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("To Zone Code",lBin."Zone Code");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("To Bin Code",lBin.Code);

      IF (lWarehouseJournalLine."To Bin Code" = lWarehouseJournalLine."From Bin Code") THEN BEGIN
        ErrorMessage := Text011;
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;


      lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);

      lItem.GET(gItemNo);
      IF NOT gIsBox THEN
        lItemTrackingCode.GET(lItem."Item Tracking Code");
      COMMIT;
      IF NOT lWarehouseJournalLine.INSERT(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.RESET;
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name");
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name");
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Location Code",lWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code");
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Line No.",lWarehouseJournalLine."Line No.");
        IF lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.DELETE;
          lWarehouseJournalLine.INSERT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;
      SetSerialNo(lWarehouseJournalLine);
      lLogisticMgt."Reg&PostWhseJnlLine"(lWarehouseJournalLine,0);
      COMMIT;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PostWhseMovementLocation@301490028(pSourceIsStructured@301490002 : Boolean) : Boolean;
    VAR
      lWarehouseJournalLine@301490000 : Record 7311;
      lWarehouseJournalLineDelete@301490008 : Record 7311;
      lWarehouseJournalBatch@301490001 : Record 7310;
      lBinContent@301490003 : Record 7302;
      lItem@301490004 : Record 27;
      lItemTrackingCode@301490005 : Record 6502;
      lBin@301490007 : Record 7354;
      lLogisticMgt@301490006 : Codeunit 5104803;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301510000 : Record 32;
    BEGIN
      // Umlagerung Strukturiert <> Unstruckturiert
      getCustomerSetup;
      // Buchblatt muss vorhanden sein!
      lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Template Type",12);
      IF pSourceIsStructured THEN BEGIN
        lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Location Code",gSourceLocation);
        lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Unstructured Location Code",gTargetLocation);
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Location Code",gTargetLocation);
        lWarehouseJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Unstructured Location Code",gSourceLocation);
      END;

      IF NOT lWarehouseJournalBatch.FINDFIRST THEN
        IF pSourceIsStructured THEN
          ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(Text003,gSourceLocation,gTargetLocation))
        ELSE
          ERROR(STRSUBSTNO(Text003,gTargetLocation,gSourceLocation));

      lWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Location Code";
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name" := lWarehouseJournalBatch.Name;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SetUnstructuredLocationCode(lWarehouseJournalBatch."Unstructured Location Code");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SetUpNewLine(lWarehouseJournalLine);
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Reason Code" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Reason Code";
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Line No." := 10000;

      //Filter setzen
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",lWarehouseJournalLine."Line No.");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name");
      lWarehouseJournalLine.SETRANGE("Location Code",lWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code");

      lWarehouseJournalLine."Unstructured Location Code" := lWarehouseJournalBatch."Unstructured Location Code";
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Item No." := gItemNo;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Variant Code" := gVariantCode;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Unit of Measure Code" := gUOM;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Whse. Document No." := USERID;
      lWarehouseJournalLine."Registering Date" := TODAY;
      lWarehouseJournalLine.Description := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME) + ' ' + FORMAT(USERID);
      IF pSourceIsStructured THEN BEGIN
        GetBinContent(lBinContent);
        IF NOT lBinContent.ISEMPTY THEN BEGIN
          lBinContent.FINDFIRST;
          lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("Zone Code",lBinContent."Zone Code");
          lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("Bin Code",lBinContent."Bin Code");
          lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,-1);
        END;
      END
      ELSE BEGIN
        lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE(Quantity,1);
        lBin.GET(gTargetLocation,gBinCode);
        lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("To Zone Code",lBin."Zone Code");
        lWarehouseJournalLine.VALIDATE("To Bin Code",gBinCode);
      END;
      //01 01.09.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung setzen
      lItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
      IF NOT gIsBox THEN BEGIN
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.");
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",gSerial);
      END ELSE
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Open);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",gItemNo);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",gVariantCode);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Quantity,1.0);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",gSerial);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Differential Taxation Purchase",TRUE);
      IF lItemLedgerEntry.FIND('+') THEN
        lWarehouseJournalLine."Devaluation Amount":=lItemLedgerEntry."Devaluation Amount";
      //01 01.09.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung setzen
      lItem.GET(gItemNo);
      IF NOT gIsBox THEN
        lItemTrackingCode.GET(lItem."Item Tracking Code");
      COMMIT;
      IF NOT lWarehouseJournalLine.INSERT(TRUE) THEN BEGIN
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.RESET;
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name");
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",lWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name");
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Location Code",lWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code");
        lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Line No.",lWarehouseJournalLine."Line No.");
        IF lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
          lWarehouseJournalLineDelete.DELETE;
          lWarehouseJournalLine.INSERT(TRUE);
        END;
      END;
      SetSerialNo(lWarehouseJournalLine);

      lLogisticMgt."Reg&PostWhseJnlLine"(lWarehouseJournalLine,1);
      COMMIT;

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PostItemReclss@301490015() : Boolean;
    VAR
      lItemJournalBatch@301490000 : Record 233;
      lItemJournalLine@301490002 : Record 83;
      lItemJournalLineDelete@301490003 : Record 83;
      lItemJnlMgt@301490001 : Codeunit 240;
      lItemJnlPost@301490004 : Codeunit 241;
    BEGIN
      // Umlagerung zwischen zwei unstrukturierten Lagerorten
      getCustomerSetup;
      lItemJournalBatch.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",gCustomerSetup.RelocationtItemJT);
      lItemJournalBatch.SETRANGE(Name,gCustomerSetup.RelocationItemName);
      IF NOT lItemJournalBatch.FINDFIRST THEN BEGIN
        ErrorMessage := STRSUBSTNO(Text010,gCustomerSetup.RelocationtItemJT,gCustomerSetup.RelocationName);
        EXIT(FALSE);
      END;
      lItemJournalLine."Journal Batch Name" := lItemJournalBatch.Name;
      lItemJournalLine."Journal Template Name" := lItemJournalBatch."Journal Template Name";
      lItemJournalLine.SetUpNewLine(lItemJournalLine);
      lItemJournalLine."Entry Type" := lItemJournalLine."Entry Type"::Transfer;
      lItemJournalLine."Line No." := 10000;
      GetItemWithSerial(lItemJournalLine);
      lItemJournalLine.FILTERGROUP(2);
      lItemJournalLine.SETRANGE("Line No.",lItemJournalLine."Line No.");
      lItemJournalLine.FILTERGROUP(0);
      lItemJournalLine."New Location Code" := gTargetLocation;
      lItemJournalLine."Reason Code" := lItemJournalBatch."Reason Code";
      lItemJournalLine."Document No." := USERID;
      lItemJournalLine."Posting Date" := TODAY;
      lItemJournalLine.Description := FORMAT(CURRENTDATETIME) + ' ' + FORMAT(USERID);
      IF NOT (lItemJournalLine.INSERT(TRUE)) THEN BEGIN
        lItemJournalLineDelete.RESET;
        lItemJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Journal Template Name",lItemJournalLine."Journal Template Name");
        lItemJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Journal Batch Name",lItemJournalLine."Journal Batch Name");
        lItemJournalLineDelete.SETRANGE("Line No.",lItemJournalLine."Line No.");
        IF lItemJournalLineDelete.FINDFIRST THEN
          lItemJournalLineDelete.DELETE;
        IF NOT (lItemJournalLine.INSERT(TRUE)) THEN
          EXIT(FALSE);
      END;

      lItemJnlPost.SetHideValidationDialog(TRUE);
      lItemJnlPost.RUN(lItemJournalLine);

      EXIT(TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetBinContent@301490040(VAR pBinContent@301490000 : Record 7302) : Boolean;
    BEGIN
      pBinContent.RESET;
      pBinContent.SETRANGE("Location Code",gSourceLocation);
      pBinContent.SETRANGE("Item No.",gItemNo);
      pBinContent.SETRANGE("Variant Code",gVariantCode);
      IF gUOM <> '' THEN
        pBinContent.SETRANGE("Unit of Measure Code",gUOM);
      IF gSerial <> '' THEN
        pBinContent.SETFILTER ("Serial No. Filter",gSerial);
      pBinContent.SETFILTER(Quantity,'>%1',0);
      EXIT(pBinContent.FINDFIRST);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SetSerialNo@301480037(VAR pWarehouseJournalLine@301480000 : Record 7311);
    VAR
      WhseItemTrackingLine@301480001 : Record 6550;
      NewEntryNo@301480002 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      WhseItemTrackingLine.RESET;
      IF WhseItemTrackingLine.FINDLAST THEN
        NewEntryNo := WhseItemTrackingLine."Entry No.";
      NewEntryNo += 1;
      WhseItemTrackingLine.INIT;
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Entry No." := NewEntryNo;
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Item No." := pWarehouseJournalLine."Item No.";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Variant Code" := pWarehouseJournalLine."Variant Code";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Location Code" := pWarehouseJournalLine."Location Code";

      WhseItemTrackingLine."Quantity (Base)" := ABS(pWarehouseJournalLine."Qty. (Base)");
      WhseItemTrackingLine.Description := pWarehouseJournalLine."Reference No.";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Source Type" := DATABASE::"Warehouse Journal Line";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Source Subtype" := 0;
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Source ID" := pWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Batch Name";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Source Batch Name" := pWarehouseJournalLine."Journal Template Name";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Source Ref. No." := pWarehouseJournalLine."Line No.";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Serial No." := gSerial;
      IF (pWarehouseJournalLine."From Bin Code" <> '') AND (pWarehouseJournalLine."To Bin Code" <> '') THEN
        WhseItemTrackingLine."New Serial No." := gSerial;
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. per Unit of Measure" := pWarehouseJournalLine."Qty. per Unit of Measure";
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. to Handle (Base)" := ABS(pWarehouseJournalLine."Qty. (Base)");
      WhseItemTrackingLine."Qty. to Handle" := ABS(pWarehouseJournalLine.Quantity);
      WhseItemTrackingLine.INSERT;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE GetItemWithSerial@301480013(VAR pItemJournalLine@301490000 : Record 83);
    VAR
      lTrackingSpecification@301480007 : Record 336;
      lItemLedgerEntry@301480006 : Record 32;
      lItemTrackingLines@301480005 : Page 6510;
      lDiVAItemTrackingMgt@301480004 : Codeunit 5104818;
      lItemNo@301480003 : Code[20];
      lVariantCode@301480002 : Code[10];
      lUnitOfMeasureCode@301480001 : Code[10];
    BEGIN
      // Direkte Kpie aus P393, daher mit with, sorry :(
      getCustomerSetup;
      WITH pItemJournalLine DO BEGIN
        lItemNo := '';
        lVariantCode := '';
        lUnitOfMeasureCode := '';
        CLEAR(lItemTrackingLines);
        IF gIsBox THEN BEGIN
          lItemNo := gItemNo;
          lVariantCode := gVariantCode;
        END ELSE
          lDiVAItemTrackingMgt.CalcItemVariantFromSerialNo(gSerial,lItemNo,lVariantCode,lUnitOfMeasureCode);
        IF lVariantCode <> '' THEN BEGIN
          VALIDATE("Item No.",lItemNo);
          VALIDATE("Variant Code",lVariantCode);
          VALIDATE(Quantity,1);
          lItemLedgerEntry.RESET;
          IF NOT gIsBox THEN BEGIN
            lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.");
            lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",gSerial);
          END ELSE
            lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Item No.","Variant Code",Open);
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.","Item No.");
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code","Variant Code");
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
          lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Quantity,1.0);
          IF lItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN BEGIN
            VALIDATE("Location Code",lItemLedgerEntry."Location Code");
            IF lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN
              VALIDATE("Differential Taxation Purchase",lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase");
            VALIDATE(Commission,lItemLedgerEntry.Commission);
            VALIDATE(Quantity,1.0);
           //01 01.09.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung Åbernehmen
           IF lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN
            "Devaluation Amount":=lItemLedgerEntry."Devaluation Amount";
           //01 01.09.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung Åbernehmen
          END ELSE BEGIN
          //01 01.09.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung Åbernehmen
            lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open);
            lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",gSerial);
            IF lItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN
              IF lItemLedgerEntry."Differential Taxation Purchase" THEN
                "Devaluation Amount":=lItemLedgerEntry."Devaluation Amount";
           //01 01.09.23 NKON CHRON-32 Abwertung Åbernehmen
          END;
          IF NOT gIsBox THEN BEGIN
            IF "Posting Date" = 0D THEN
              VALIDATE("Posting Date",WORKDATE);
            CurrPage.UPDATE(TRUE);
            COMMIT;
            lTrackingSpecification.InitFromItemJnlLine(pItemJournalLine);
            lItemTrackingLines.SetFormRunMode(1);
            lItemTrackingLines.SetSourceSpec(lTrackingSpecification,"Posting Date");
            lItemTrackingLines.SetInbound(IsInbound);
            lItemTrackingLines.SetSerialNo(gSerial);
            lItemTrackingLines.ToDosOnClosePage;
          END;
        END ELSE BEGIN
          VALIDATE("Item No.",lItemNo);
        END;
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CalcSourceLocation@301490002(pSerialNo@301490000 : Code[20];pItemNo@301490003 : Code[20];pVariantCode@301490002 : Code[10];pUOM@301490001 : Code[10]) rLocation : Code[10];
    VAR
      lItemLedgerEntry@301490004 : Record 32;
      lLocation@301490005 : Record 14;
    BEGIN
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETCURRENTKEY("Serial No.");
      IF pSerialNo <> '' THEN
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Serial No.",pSerialNo);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Open,TRUE);
      lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE(Positive,TRUE);
      IF pItemNo <> '' THEN
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Item No.",pItemNo);
      IF pVariantCode <> '' THEN
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Variant Code",pVariantCode);
      IF pUOM <> '' THEN
        lItemLedgerEntry.SETRANGE("Unit of Measure Code",pUOM);
      IF lItemLedgerEntry.FINDLAST THEN
        IF lLocation.GET(lItemLedgerEntry."Location Code") THEN
          rLocation := lLocation.Code;

      gItemNo1:=lItemLedgerEntry."Item No.";
      gVariant1:=lItemLedgerEntry."Variant Code";
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE Reset@301490019(pResetErrorMessage@301490000 : Boolean);
    BEGIN
      NextAction := NextAction::ItemNo;
      CLEAR(LastScancode);
      CLEAR(LastAction);
      IF pResetErrorMessage THEN
      CLEAR(ErrorMessage);
      ClearScanVariables;
      Scancode := '';
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE MessageBoxAddinReady@1000000004();
    BEGIN
      CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.SetAddInSize(900,40);
      Color := Color.Color;
      IF STRPOS(UPPERCASE(ErrorMessage),UPPERCASE(Text001)) = 1 THEN
        CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.ForeColor(Color.Red)
      ELSE
        CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.ForeColor(Color.Black);
      CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.WordWrap(TRUE);

      Font := Font.Font('ARIAL',14);
      CurrPage.CtrlErrorMessage.Font(Font);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DoBeep@301490000(pError@301490000 : Boolean);
    BEGIN
      getCustomerSetup;

      IF pError THEN
        IF gMagicPathError <> '' THEN
          PlayBeep(gMagicPathError)
        ELSE BEGIN
          DownloadBeep;
          PlayBeep(gMagicPathError);
        END
      ELSE IF NOT pError THEN
        IF gMagicPath <> '' THEN
          PlayBeep(gMagicPath)
        ELSE BEGIN
          DownloadBeep;
          PlayBeep(gMagicPath);
        END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE PlayBeep@301490003(pMagicPath@301490000 : Text) : Text;
    VAR
      Soundplayer@301490002 : DotNet "'System, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b77a5c561934e089'.System.Media.SoundPlayer" RUNONCLIENT;
    BEGIN
      IF pMagicPath = '' THEN
        EXIT(Text012);
      Soundplayer := Soundplayer.SoundPlayer;
      Soundplayer.SoundLocation(pMagicPath);
      Soundplayer.Load;
      Soundplayer.Play;
      Soundplayer.Dispose;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE DownloadBeep@301490005();
    VAR
      IStream@301490000 : InStream;
    BEGIN
      IF gCustomerSetup.ErrorBeep.HASVALUE THEN BEGIN
        gCustomerSetup.ErrorBeep.CREATEINSTREAM(IStream);
        DOWNLOADFROMSTREAM(IStream,'','<TEMP>','',gMagicPathError);
      END;
      IF gCustomerSetup.DoneBeep.HASVALUE THEN BEGIN
        gCustomerSetup.DoneBeep.CREATEINSTREAM(IStream);
        DOWNLOADFROMSTREAM(IStream,'','<TEMP>','',gMagicPath);
      END;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE getCustomerSetup@301480005();
    BEGIN
      IF NOT hasCustomerSetup THEN BEGIN
        gCustomerSetup.GET;
        gCustomerSetup.CALCFIELDS(ErrorBeep,DoneBeep);
      END;
      hasCustomerSetup := TRUE;
    END;

    END;

       END;
    END;

                           // 01 15.07.19 LACK CHR-548 Anforderungen Artikel / Varianten Ende

  {
    VAR
      OffsetID@301490000 : Integer;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE FillRec@301490001();
    VAR
      ItemAttribute@301490000 : Record 7500;
      SystemValueLine@301490001 : Record 5105031;
      FunctionID@301490003 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      IF ItemAttribute.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          INIT;
          ID := ItemAttribute.ID;
          Name := ItemAttribute.Name;
          Blocked := FALSE;
          INSERT;
        UNTIL ItemAttribute.NEXT = 0;

      // seperator
      OffsetID := 7000;
      INIT;
      ID := OffsetID;
      Name := '### Artikel Funktionen ###';
      INSERT;

      // fake Item Functions as Item Attributes
      SystemValueLine.SETCURRENTKEY(Description);
      SystemValueLine.SETRANGE("System Value No.",85000);
      IF SystemValueLine.FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          IF EVALUATE(FunctionID,SystemValueLine."System Code") THEN BEGIN
            INIT;
            ID := OffsetID + FunctionID;
            Name := SystemValueLine.Description;
            Blocked := FALSE;
            "Has Children" := TRUE; // marks item functions
            "Parent Attribute ID" := FunctionID; // save "real" function id
            INSERT;
          END;
        UNTIL SystemValueLine.NEXT = 0;

      IF FINDFIRST THEN;
    END;

    PROCEDURE GetTempTable@301490000(VAR ItemAttribute@301490000 : Record 7500);
    BEGIN
      IF NOT ItemAttribute.ISTEMPORARY THEN
        EXIT;

      SETRANGE(Blocked,TRUE);
      SETFILTER(ID,'<>%1',OffsetID);
      IF FINDSET THEN
        REPEAT
          ItemAttribute.INIT;
          ItemAttribute.TRANSFERFIELDS(Rec);
          ItemAttribute.INSERT;
        UNTIL NEXT = 0;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SelectAll@301490002();
    BEGIN
      MODIFYALL(Blocked,TRUE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CancelSelection@301490003();
    BEGIN
      MODIFYALL(Blocked,FALSE);
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SelectAllAttributes@301490004();
    BEGIN
      SETRANGE("Has Children",FALSE);
      MODIFYALL(Blocked,TRUE);
      RESET;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE SelectAllFunctions@301490007();
    BEGIN
      SETRANGE("Has Children",TRUE);
      MODIFYALL(Blocked,TRUE);
      RESET;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CancelAttributeSelection@301490005();
    BEGIN
      SETRANGE("Has Children",FALSE);
      MODIFYALL(Blocked,FALSE);
      RESET;
    END;

    LOCAL PROCEDURE CancelFunctionSelection@301490006();
    BEGIN
      SETRANGE("Has Children",TRUE);
      MODIFYALL(Blocked,FALSE);
      RESET;
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      // 01 02.07.19 MBLA CHR-548 Anforderungen Artikel / Varianten: Export Attribute vor Report
    }
    END.
  }

    VAR
      PSPLog@301480000 : Record 5227626;
